title_quote: Excuse me, is the lounge upstairs?

youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Airport Lounge
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「機場貴賓室」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），共 800 句、400 輪，全程只在貴賓室裡面發生的事：跟著指標找到電梯、給人員檢查會員卡、座位全滿時怎麼辦、詢問熱食與餐點、洗一場熱水澡、在安靜區小睡、盯著班次螢幕看異動、以及延誤時請求多留一小時。全部以 A2 級簡易句寫成，句句對應中文翻譯，睡前循環播放即可。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'At the Airport Lounge' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — 800 sentences, 400 turns, all inside the lounge: finding the lift by the signs, showing your membership card, a full room, the buffet line, a hot shower, a nap in the quiet zone, gate changes on the board and asking to stay one extra hour when your flight is delayed. Easy A2 sentences on repeat. #EnglishListening #SleepEnglish #LearnEnglish

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is the lounge upstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ɪz ðə laʊndʒ ˌʌpˈstɛrz?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，貴賓室在樓上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, take the lift to level three.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs teɪk ðə lɪft tu ˈlɛvəl θriː./
dialogue.zh: 對，搭電梯到三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the sign for the lounge point?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə saɪn fɔr ðə laʊndʒ pɔɪnt?/
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室的指標指向哪邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It points right past the duty-free shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɔɪnts raɪt pæst ðə ˈduti fri ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 往免稅店那頭指過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lounge lift past duty free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə laʊndʒ lɪft pæst ˈduti fri?/
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室電梯在免稅店那一邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stands behind the coffee bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt stændz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkɔfi bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 是的，就在咖啡吧台後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take the escalator or the lift?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ði ˈɛskəˌleɪtər ɔr ðə lɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 我該走電扶梯還是電梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lift is easier with your bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪft ɪz ˈizɪɚ wɪð jɔr bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 你帶著行李，搭電梯方便些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My suitcase wheels are loud on tile.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsutkeɪs wilz ɑr laʊd ɑn taɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我行李箱的輪子在磁磚上很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the soft carpet near the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə sɔft ˈkɑrpɪt nɪr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 走窗邊那塊軟地毯會安靜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the signs point the same way back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə saɪnz pɔɪnt ðə seɪm weɪ bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 回去也照同樣的指標走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the exit signs are separate.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði ˈɛɡzɪt saɪnz ɑr ˈsɛpərət./
dialogue.zh: 不是，出口的指標是另一套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This corridor looks very long to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs kəˈrɔr lʊks ˈvɛri lɔŋ tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 這條走廊看起來好長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It bends once, then you see glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt bɛndz wʌns ðɛn ju si ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 轉一個彎，就能看到玻璃門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the lounge from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr ɪz ðə laʊndʒ frʌm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 從這裡到貴賓室有多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About four minutes on foot, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt fɔr ˈmɪnɪts ɑn fʊt ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走大約四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a step-free way to the lift?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈstɛp fri weɪ tu ðə lɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 有不用爬階梯的路到電梯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the ramp starts by the duty-free shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ræmp stɑrts baɪ ðə ˈduti fri ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 有的，斜坡從免稅店那邊起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which lift is closest to the lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ lɪft ɪz ˈkloʊsɪst tu ðə laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 哪台電梯離貴賓室最近？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one beside the newsstand, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði wʌn bɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈnuzstænd sɜr./
dialogue.zh: 書報攤旁那台，先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good, that lift is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd ðæt lɪft ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那台電梯就在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the lounge door is past it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə laʊndʒ dɔr ɪz pæst ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，再往前的門就是貴賓室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sign shows a wheelchair and a stroller.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪn ʃoʊz ə ˈwaɪlˌtʃɛr ænd ə ˈstrɑlər./
dialogue.zh: 牌子上有輪椅和嬰兒車的圖示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a shared lift for everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə ʃɛrd lɪft fɔr ˈɛvriˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那是所有人共用的電梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I push my cart into the lift?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pʊʃ maɪ kɑrt ˈɪntu ðə lɪft?/
dialogue.zh: 我能把手推車推進電梯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but turn it to face out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt tɜrn ɪt tu feɪs aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但把它轉成面朝外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this lift stop at level three?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs lɪft stɑp æt ˈlɛvəl θriː?/
dialogue.zh: 這台電梯會停在三樓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops at two and three only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps æt tu ænd θriː ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 只停二樓和三樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard the lounge moved to the east wing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ðə laʊndʒ muvd tu ði ist wɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我聽說貴賓室搬到東側了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the east wing is a spa now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ði ist wɪŋ ɪz ə spɑ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，東側現在是水療區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the right floor for the lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə raɪt flɔr fɔr ðə laʊndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室是在這一層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, turn left when the doors open.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɜrn lɛft wɛn ðə dɔrz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 是的，門一開就往左轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, you helped me a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ju hɛlpt mi ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，你幫了我很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any time, enjoy your flight today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔr flaɪt təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，祝你今天航班順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lounge sign is small above the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laʊndʒ saɪn ɪz smɔl əˈbʌv ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室的牌子小小掛在門上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it now, next to the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt naʊ nɛkst tu ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我現在看到了，就在燈旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I in the right place now?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ɪn ðə raɪt pleɪs naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在是走對地方了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are, push the glass door gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr pʊʃ ðə ɡlæs dɔr ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 對了，輕輕推玻璃門進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone map says this way, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn mæp sɛz ðɪs weɪ raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我手機地圖說走這邊，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maps are wrong inside this terminal.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæps ɑr rɔŋ ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs ˈtɜrmənəl./
dialogue.zh: 航廈裡的手機地圖常常不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find the lounge entrance?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ faɪnd ðə laʊndʒ ˈɛntrəns?/
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室入口要往哪兒找？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is behind the blue curtain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə blu ˈkɜrtən./
dialogue.zh: 就在藍色布簾後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to show anything here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu ʃoʊ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 到這裡需要先給人家看什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only your card at the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli jɔr kɑrd æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 只要在工作台前出示你的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it open all night, do you know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈoʊpən ɔl naɪt du ju noʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 它整晚都開嗎，你知道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It closes when the last flight leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkloʊzɪz wɛn ðə læst flaɪt livz./
dialogue.zh: 最後一班起飛後就關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The escalator looks stopped tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛskəˌleɪtər lʊks stɑpt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 電扶梯今晚好像停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, staff stopped it for cleaning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs stæf stɑpt ɪt fɔr ˈklinɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 是的，員工為了清潔關掉它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I take the lift instead, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ teɪk ðə lɪft ɪnˈstɛd ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 那我改搭電梯，慢慢走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, it opens on this side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ɪt ˈoʊpənz ɑn ðɪs saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 很好，它就在這邊開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button is for the third floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbʌtən ɪz fɔr ðə θɜrd flɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個按鈕是三樓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green one, second from the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɡrin wʌn ˈsɛkənd frʌm ðə tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 綠色那個，從上面數第二個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is crowded inside the lift already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈkraʊdɪd ɪnˈsaɪd ðə lɪft ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 電梯裡已經擠滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait a bit, the next car is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ə bɪt ðə nɛkst kɑr ɪz ˈɛmpi./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，下一趟是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can smell coffee from this far.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn smɛl ˈkɔfi frʌm ðɪs fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 隔這麼遠就聞到咖啡香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the coffee bar on your left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈkɔfi bɑr ɑn jɔr lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 那是咖啡吧台，在你左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep my ticket in my hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip maɪ ˈtɪkɪt ɪn maɪ hænd?/
dialogue.zh: 我該把票一直拿在手上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the desk will ask for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə dɛsk wɪl æsk fɔr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 要的，工作台會跟你要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I allowed to bring water in?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ əˈlaʊd tu brɪŋ ˈwɔtər ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶水進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but not from outside the airport.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt nɑt frʌm ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ði ˈɛrpɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但機場外面買的不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sign says lounge, spa, then quiet zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪn sɛz laʊndʒ spɑ ðɛn ˈkwaɪət zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫貴賓室、水療、安靜區。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the quiet zone is farthest in.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈkwaɪət zoʊn ɪz ˈfɑrθɪst ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，安靜區在最裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I walk slowly, sorry about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɔk ˈsloʊli ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我走得慢，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, I will wait here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm aɪ wɪl weɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你慢慢來，我在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do Chinese staff work at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du tʃaɪˈniz stæf wɜrk æt ðə dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 工作台有說中文的人員嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two of them are on today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ʌv ðɛm ɑr ɑn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有，今天兩位在班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I leave my big backpack?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ liv maɪ bɪɡ ˈbækˌpæk?/
dialogue.zh: 我的大背包可以放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelf close to the desk holds bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlf kloʊs tu ðə dɛsk hoʊldz bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 架子在櫃台附近，是放行李的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that shelf inside the lounge already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ʃɛlf ɪnˈsaɪd ðə laʊndʒ ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 那個架子已經在貴賓室裡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is just past the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz dʒʌst pæst ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 不，它在門外那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep walking past the same plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ˈwɔkɪŋ pæst ðə seɪm plænt./
dialogue.zh: 我一直經過同一棵盆栽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third door after it, you are close.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd dɔr ˈæftər ɪt ju ɑr kloʊs./
dialogue.zh: 再過去第三道門就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the lounge have one floor or two?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə laʊndʒ hæv wʌn flɔr ɔr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室有一層還是兩層？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only this floor, all on one level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðɪs flɔr ɔl ɑn wʌn ˈlɛvəl./
dialogue.zh: 只有這一層，全在同一個平面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the lift far from the buffet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə lɪft fɑr frʌm ðə bʊˈfeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 電梯離自助餐台遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, three steps to your right.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ θri stɛps tu jɔr raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不遠，你右邊三步就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my feet are very tired today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ fit ɑr ˈvɛri ˈtaɪərd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我今天腳好累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sit at the bar for a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɪt æt ðə bɑr fɔr ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那先在吧台坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question about the flight screens.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ðə flaɪt skrinz./
dialogue.zh: 還有一個關於班機螢幕的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hang above the dining tables.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ hæŋ əˈbʌv ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ ˈteɪbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 它們掛在餐桌的正上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that saves me a search.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðæt seɪvz mi ə sɜrtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，省得我四處找。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk slowly, the floor is shiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk ˈsloʊli ðə flɔr ɪz ˈʃaɪni./
dialogue.zh: 慢點走，地板剛打過蠟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found it, the blue sign at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ɪt ðə blu saɪn æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 我終於看到那個藍色牌子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, enjoy your stay with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔr steɪ wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，請好好享受在這裡的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the desk straight ahead of me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə dɛsk streɪt əˈhɛd ʌv mi?/
dialogue.zh: 工作台就在我正前方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two steps and you are there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu stɛps ænd ju ɑr ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 是的，再兩步就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The path was hard to find today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pæθ wʌz hɑrd tu faɪnd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天的路有點難找。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New signs go up next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu saɪnz ɡoʊ ʌp nɛkst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 下個月會換新的指標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I turn right after the shoe shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tɜrn raɪt ˈæftər ðə ʃu ʃɑp?/
dialogue.zh: 經過鞋店之後要右轉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the shoe shop moved last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ʃu ʃɑp muvd læst wik./
dialogue.zh: 不，鞋店上週搬走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then what landmark should I look for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌt ˈlændˌmɑrk ʃʊd aɪ lʊk fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 那我該找哪個地標？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big water bottle by the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪɡ ˈwɔtər ˈbɑtəl baɪ ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 牆邊有一個大水壺造型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh yes, I know that one well.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jɛs aɪ noʊ ðæt wʌn wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 喔，那個我很熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lift is right behind that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪft ɪz raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 電梯就在那個後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, is this lift for guests only?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri ɪz ðɪs lɪft fɔr ɡɛsts ˈoʊnli?/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，這台電梯只給旅客用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is open to all guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz ˈoʊpən tu ɔl ɡɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 是的，所有旅客都能搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife is lost near gate twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf ɪz lɔst nɪr ɡeɪt ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 我太太在二十號登機門附近走散了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her the lounge lift is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr ðə laʊndʒ lɪft ɪz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 跟她說貴賓室電梯就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says she sees the blue curtain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ʃi siz ðə blu ˈkɜrtən./
dialogue.zh: 她說她看到藍色布簾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, she is almost at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ʃi ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 很好，她幾乎就到門口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my card and boarding pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ kɑrd ænd ˈbɔrdɪŋ pæs./
dialogue.zh: 這是我的卡和登機證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I will scan the barcode.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju aɪ wɪl skæn ðə ˈbɑrˌkoʊd./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我掃一下條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need my passport too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid maɪ ˈpæspɔrt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 護照也要給你看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for foreign flights, not this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr ˈfɔrən flaɪts nɑt ðɪs wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 只有國際線要，這班不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card is a gold membership card.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd ɪz ə ɡoʊld məmˈbərʃɪp kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我這張是黃金會員卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, gold guests may bring two people.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡoʊld ɡɛsts meɪ brɪŋ tu ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 是的，黃金會員可帶兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my wife allowed in with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ waɪf əˈlaʊd ɪn wɪθ mi?/
dialogue.zh: 我太太能跟我一起進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I am adding her name now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ æm ˈædɪŋ hɜr neɪm naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我正在登她的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the scanner does not read it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə ˈskænər dʌz nɑt rid ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果讀卡機讀不到怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the paper pass in your pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈpeɪpər pæs ɪn jɔr ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 試試你口袋裡的紙本登機證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone battery is almost dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ˈbætəri ɪz ˈɔlmoʊst dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我手機快沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can print a pass at this desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn prɪnt ə pæs æt ðɪs dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這張台印一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please print it, thank you so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz prɪnt ɪt θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 麻煩印一張，真的謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, here is a paper copy for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn hɪr ɪz ə ˈpeɪpər ˈkɑpi fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 好了，這是給你的紙本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this card work for both directions?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs kɑrd wɜrk fɔr boʊθ dəˈrɛkʃənz?/
dialogue.zh: 這張卡去程回程都能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both times on the same day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs boʊθ taɪmz ɑn ðə seɪm deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，同一天進兩次都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay for a guest right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ fɔr ə ɡɛst raɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我能在這裡幫同行的人買票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one guest costs thirty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ɡɛst kɔsts ˈθɜrdi ˈdɑlərz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，一位是三十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card or cash for the guest fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɔr kæʃ fɔr ðə ɡɛst fi?/
dialogue.zh: 賓客費用刷卡還是付現？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both are fine, we take either one.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɑr faɪn wi teɪk ˈiːðər wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 都行，兩種我們都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my app shows a QR code now.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt maɪ æp ʃoʊz ə ˌkiˈɑr koʊd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的應用程式現在有條碼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I can scan that on your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ kæn skæn ðæt ɑn jɔr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我掃你手機螢幕就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the code too small to read?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə koʊd tu smɔl tu rid?/
dialogue.zh: 條碼會不會小到讀不到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can zoom it on my screen, no worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn zum ɪt ɑn maɪ skrin noʊ ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 我這邊能放大，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen says not valid, why is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin sɛz nɑt ˈvælɪd waɪ ɪz ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕寫無效，是為什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check, your card may be old.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk jɔr kɑrd meɪ bi oʊld./
dialogue.zh: 我查一下，你的卡可能過期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you try it one more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju traɪ ɪt wʌn mɔr taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 能請你再試刷一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hold it flat against the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hoʊld ɪt flæt əˈɡɛnst ðə ˈridər./
dialogue.zh: 好，把卡平貼在讀卡機上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it beeps green, that is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt bipz ɡrin ðæt ɪz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 現在嗶一聲變綠燈了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works, the first try was too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks ðə fɜrst traɪ wʌz tu fæst./
dialogue.zh: 通了，剛剛刷得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign anything at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ saɪn ˈɛniˌθɪŋ æt ðə dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要在台前簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only your name and the flight number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli jɔr neɪm ænd ðə flaɪt ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 只寫你的名字和航班編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name is hard to spell, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz hɑrd tu spɛl ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 我的名字不好拼，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will copy it from your pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈkɑpi ɪt frʌm jɔr pæs./
dialogue.zh: 我照你的登機證抄就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many guests did you write down?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ɡɛsts dɪd ju raɪt daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 你登記了幾位賓客？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three in total, one is your boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɪn ˈtoʊtəl wʌn ɪz jɔr bɔɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一共三位，其中一位是你家男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my kid eat with us up there?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ kɪd it wɪð ʌs ʌp ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我小孩能在上面跟我們一起吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, children eat free before twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈtʃɪldrən it fri bɪˈfɔr twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 可以，十二歲以下用餐免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps, our boy is only nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps aʊr bɔɪ ɪz ˈoʊnli naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那太好了，我們家男孩才九歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will note it, no charge for him.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪt noʊ tʃɑrdʒ fɔr hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我註記一下，他不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any time limit for staying in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni taɪm ˈlɪmɪt fɔr ˈsteɪɪŋ ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 在裡面待多久有時間限制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hours before your boarding time.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈaʊərz bɪˈfɔr jɔr ˈbɔrdɪŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 登機時間前三小時內可進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three hours is plenty for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈaʊərz ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 三小時對我們夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may keep the stamp on your pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ kip ðə stæmp ɑn jɔr pæs./
dialogue.zh: 時間章可以留在你的證上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this stamp for, may I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðɪs stæmp fɔr meɪ aɪ æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 請問這個章是做什麼用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows staff when you came in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz stæf wɛn ju keɪm ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 讓人員知道你是幾點進來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we like to sit down early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi laɪk tu sɪt daʊn ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 好，我們喜歡早一點坐下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early guests get the calm corners.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɜrli ɡɛsts ɡɛt ðə kɑm ˈkɔrnərz./
dialogue.zh: 早來的人能坐到安靜角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have wifi for members here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hav ˈwaɪfaɪ fɔr ˈmɛmbərz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有給會員用的無線網路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the code is under your stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə koʊd ɪz ˈʌndər jɔr stæmp./
dialogue.zh: 有，密碼印在你的時間章下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the stamp, I see it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə stæmp aɪ si ɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 章的下面，我看到密碼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works best near the reading lamps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks bɛst nɪr ðə ˈridɪŋ læmpz./
dialogue.zh: 在閱讀燈附近收訊最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a printed lounge map?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈprɪntɪd laʊndʒ mæp?/
dialogue.zh: 能給我一張紙本地圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, it lists food, showers, quiet seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt lɪsts fud ˈʃaʊərz ˈkwaɪət sits./
dialogue.zh: 給您，上面列餐區、淋浴、座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the showers on this floor too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈʃaʊərz ɑn ðɪs flɔr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 淋浴間也在這一層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, at the end past the glass wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æt ði ɛnd pæst ðə ɡlæs wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 是的，走到底過玻璃牆就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I book a shower at your desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ bʊk ə ˈʃaʊər æt jɔr dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 淋浴要在你這邊預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can put you in at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ kæn pʊt ju ɪn æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 可以，我幫你排七點那場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven is good, we eat before that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ɪz ɡʊd wi it bɪˈfɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 七點好，我們在那之前先吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put a fresh towel in five.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊt ə frɛʃ ˈtaʊəl ɪn faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我會放一條乾淨毛巾在五號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made this easy, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ðɪs ˈizi θæŋk ju./
dialogue.zh: 你讓整個過程很輕鬆，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy your evening here, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔr ˈiːvnɪŋ hɪr sɜr./
dialogue.zh: 先生，請好好享受在這裡的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the membership card the same everywhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə məmˈbərʃɪp kɑrd ðə seɪm ˈɛvriˌwɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 會員卡到哪間機場都通用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly yes, but rules change by airport.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli jɛs bʌt rulz tʃeɪndʒ baɪ ˈɛrpɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 大致是，不過每家機場規定不同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This airport is very strict, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɛrpɔrt ɪz ˈvɛri strikt ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那間機場管得特別緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only about cards, everything else is calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt kɑrdz ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɛls ɪz kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 只有卡在管，其他都很放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my name is not on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf maɪ neɪm ɪz nɑt ɑn ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果名單上沒有我的名字呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show your card, I can fix it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ jɔr kɑrd aɪ kæn fɪks ɪt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 把卡給我，我很快就能改好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing, do we keep these passes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ du wi kip ðiz ˈpæsɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 有件事，這些入場證要留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep yours, I will file the guest copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip jɔrz aɪ wɪl faɪl ðə ɡɛst ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 你的收著，賓客那聯我歸檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I go right after this desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ ɡoʊ raɪt ˈæftər ðɪs dɛsk?/
dialogue.zh: 離開這張台之後我要往哪走？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straight past the curtain, then you sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt pæst ðə ˈkɜrtən ðɛn ju sɪt./
dialogue.zh: 直走過布簾，就可以坐下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave bags here for an hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi liv bæɡz hɪr fɔr ɑn ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能先把行李放這一個小時嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tag them with this paper slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæɡ ðɛm wɪð ðɪs ˈpeɪpər slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 可以，用這張紙牌做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is one slip for each bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz wʌn slɪp fɔr itʃ bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 一個袋子要一張牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One slip covers all your bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn slɪp ˈkʌvərz ɔl jɔr bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 一張牌就能管你所有行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both cases are right here with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈkeɪsɪz ɑr raɪt hɪr wɪð ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 兩個行李箱都在我們身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see them, no need to write more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðɛm noʊ nid tu raɪt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，不用再多寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a seat number too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə sit ˈnʌmbər tu?/
dialogue.zh: 座位號碼也要登記嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No numbers here, any seat you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈnʌmbərz hɪr ˈɛni sit ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 這裡不記號碼，位子隨意坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free seating, that is the best part.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈsitɪŋ ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 隨意入座，這是最棒的一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just not the two seats by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst nɑt ðə tu sits baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 只是門邊那兩個位子不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why not those two by the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt ðoʊz tu baɪ ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼門邊那兩個不能坐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stay free for guests with kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ steɪ fri fɔr ɡɛsts wɪð kɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 那兩個留給帶小孩的旅客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Makes sense, our bags are small today.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns aʊr bæɡz ɑr smɔl təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 有道理，我們今天行李不大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the window row, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ðə ˈwɪndoʊ roʊ pliz./
dialogue.zh: 那就坐到靠窗那一排吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we go, one thing about lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ wʌn θɪŋ əˈbaʊt lʌntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 進去之前，還有一件關於吃的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The buffet opens in fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊˈfeɪ ˈoʊpənz ɪn fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 自助餐台十五分鐘後開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is lunch included in the card already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz lʌntʃ ɪnˈkludid ɪn ðə kɑrd ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 餐點已經含在卡裡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, food and drinks cost nothing here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fud ænd drɪŋks kɔst ˈnʌθɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 是的，這裡飲食都不另收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing at all, not even coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ət ɔl nɑt ˈivən ˈkɔfi?/
dialogue.zh: 完全不收，連咖啡也不？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not even the fancy drinks with foam.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈivən ðə ˈfænsi drɪŋks wɪð foʊm./
dialogue.zh: 連加奶泡的花式飲品也不收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful, we will sit down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndərfəl wi wɪl sɪt daʊn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們現在進去坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy, here is the pass for your wife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ hɪr ɪz ðə pæs fɔr jɔr waɪf./
dialogue.zh: 慢用，這張是您太太的入場證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, and my son gets one too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd maɪ sʌn ɡɛts wʌn tu?/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我兒子也拿到一張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I wrote him in as guest two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ roʊt hɪm ɪn æz ɡɛst tu./
dialogue.zh: 是的，我把他登記成第二位賓客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are fast, we are still standing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr fæst wi ɑr stɪl ˈstændɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你們手好快，我們都還站著沒坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do this forty times an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ðɪs ˈfɔrti taɪmz ɑn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 我們一個小時要辦四十次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are all set, nothing more, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ɔl sɛt ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們都辦好了，沒別的事了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing more, walk past the curtain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr wɔk pæst ðə ˈkɜrtən./
dialogue.zh: 沒別的了，走過布簾就是裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room looks full already tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum lʊks fʊl ɔlˈrɛdi təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚裡面好像已經坐滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, two tables by the window only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst tu ˈteɪbəlz baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，只剩窗邊兩桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those two are for four people, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz tu ɑr fɔr fɔr ˈpipəl raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那兩桌是給四人座的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we keep them for groups.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kip ðɛm fɔr ɡrupz./
dialogue.zh: 是的，那些留給團體客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are only two, can we fit in?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ˈoʊnli tu kæn wi fɪt ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們只有兩個人，能擠一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me see, one round table is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi si wʌn raʊnd ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 我看看，有一張圓桌是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, our bags take a lot of room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ˈaʊər bæɡz teɪk ə lɑt ʌv rum./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們的行李很佔空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may put one under the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ pʊt wʌn ˈʌndər ðə tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你可以把一件塞到椅子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the chair, good thinking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə tʃɛr ɡʊd ˈθɪŋkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 放椅子下面，想得真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The other case can stay by your legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈʌðər keɪs kæn steɪ baɪ jɔr lɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 另一件就留在你腿邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do round tables have plugs for charging?
dialogue.phonetic: /du raʊnd ˈteɪbəlz hæv plʌɡz fɔr ˈtʃɑrdʒɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 圓桌上有充電用的插座嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one socket under each table top.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈsɑkɪt ˈʌndər itʃ ˈteɪbəl tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 有，每張桌面下面各一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my laptop is at four percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp ɪz æt fɔr pərˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我筆電只剩百分之四。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the long desk with the lamps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ðə lɔŋ dɛsk wɪð ðə læmpz./
dialogue.zh: 那就去有台燈的那張長桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The long desk is full, I just looked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔŋ dɛsk ɪz fʊl aɪ dʒʌst lʊkt./
dialogue.zh: 長桌已經滿了，我剛去看了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, that desk opens again at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri ðæt dɛsk ˈoʊpənz əˈɡɛn æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，那桌七點才清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven is too late for my laptop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ɪz tu leɪt fɔr maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp./
dialogue.zh: 七點太晚了，我的筆電撐不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the bar stools near the coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bɑr stulz nɪr ðə ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 那就坐咖啡區的高腳凳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those stools comfortable for one hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoʊz stulz ˈkʌmpərtəbl fɔr wʌn ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 那些高凳坐一小時還舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fairly, they have a small foot rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪrli ðeɪ hæv ə smɔl fʊt rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 還行，下面有一個小腳踏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A family with kids took the soft seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfæməli wɪð kɪdz tʊk ðə sɔft sits./
dialogue.zh: 一個帶小孩的家庭坐了沙發區。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in the play corner now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr ɪn ðə pleɪ ˈkɔrnər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他們現在在兒童那一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good for them, we like quiet more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd fɔr ðɛm wi laɪk ˈkwaɪət mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 他們真好，我們比較愛安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The quiet side needs a soft voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkwaɪət saɪd nidz ə sɔft vɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 安靜那一邊要放低聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the wait for a table?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə weɪt fɔr ə ˈteɪbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 等一張桌子要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe ten minutes, two guests are leaving.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi tɛn ˈmɪnɪts tu ɡɛsts ɑr ˈlivɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 大概十分鐘，有兩位要走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, we can stand that long.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts wi kæn stænd ðæt lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘而已，我們站得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or lean at the ledge by the plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr lin æt ði lɛdʒ baɪ ðə plænts./
dialogue.zh: 或是靠盆栽邊那條台面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That ledge has no back support.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt lɛdʒ hæz noʊ bæk səˈpɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 那個台面沒有靠背。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, but your legs get a rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru bʌt jɔr lɛɡz ɡɛt ə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 也是，但你的腿能休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back hurts from the long walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæk hɜrts frʌm ðə lɔŋ wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 走太久，我的背有點痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ask for a chair with arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æsk fɔr ə tʃɛr wɪð ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 那就要求一張有扶手的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chairs with arms are all taken, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛrz wɪð ɑrmz ɑr ɔl ˈteɪkən aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 有扶手的好像都被坐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two are free in the work corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɑr fri ɪn ðə wɜrk ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 工作區那邊還有兩個空位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Work corner, is that near the screens?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrk ˈkɔrnər ɪz ðæt nɪr ðə skrinz?/
dialogue.zh: 工作區靠近班機螢幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can see them from your seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju kæn si ðɛm frʌm jɔr sit./
dialogue.zh: 可以，從你的座位就看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two chairs in a corner, that fits us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tʃɛrz ɪn ə ˈkɔrnər ðæt fɪts ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 角落兩個位子，我們剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will show you, it is just there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃoʊ ju ɪt ɪz dʒʌst ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我帶你去，就在那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One chair faces the wall, that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tʃɛr ˈfeɪsɪz ðə wɔl ðæt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 有一張面牆，那沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wall side is the calmest here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔl saɪd ɪz ðə ˈkɑlmɪst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 面牆那一邊是這裡最靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these chairs tilt back a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz tʃɛrz tɪlt bæk ə ˈlɪtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 這些椅子能往後傾一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, push the lever on your right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pʊʃ ðə ˈlivər ɑn jɔr raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，壓你右手邊那個撥桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, it goes back quite far.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ɪt ɡoʊz bæk kwaɪt fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，能往後倒還不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not sleep flat in this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du nɑt slip flæt ɪn ðɪs wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 請別把這張完全躺平睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, only a short rest for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndərˈstʊd ˈoʊnli ə ʃɔrt rɛst fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 了解，我只短暫休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set a clock, we text you at boarding.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ə klɑk wi tɛkst ju æt ˈbɔrdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 設個鬧鐘，登機時我們會傳訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You text guests here when boarding starts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tɛkst ɡɛsts hɪr wɛn ˈbɔrdɪŋ stɑrts?/
dialogue.zh: 開始登機時，這邊會傳訊息給旅客？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the message comes to your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈmɛsɪdʒ kʌmz tu jɔr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 是的，訊息會傳到你的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I do not like being called out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ du nɑt laɪk ˈbiɪŋ kɔld aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 好，我不喜歡被大聲喊名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Few guests do, so we write it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fju ɡɛsts du soʊ wi raɪt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 很少旅客喜歡，所以我們用寫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tray on my table is a bonus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪ ɑn maɪ ˈteɪbəl ɪz ə ˈboʊnəs./
dialogue.zh: 桌上有托盤，這多加分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may set your cup and plate there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ sɛt jɔr kʌp ænd pleɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 你可以把杯子和盤子放上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also a hook for my jacket, nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ə hʊk fɔr maɪ ˈdʒækɪt naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 還有掛外套的鉤子，真不賴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it, the floor gets crowded fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt ðə flɔr ɡɛts ˈkraʊdɪd fæst./
dialogue.zh: 掛上去吧，地上一下就很擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move this chair a little closer?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muv ðɪs tʃɛr ə ˈlɪtəl ˈkloʊsər?/
dialogue.zh: 我能把這張椅子挪近一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but leave space for the cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs bʌt liv speɪs fɔr ðə kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但留個位置給推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cleaning cart comes by every hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈklinɪŋ kɑrt kʌmz baɪ ˈɛvri ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 清潔推車每小時都會來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only twice, usually before the buffet opens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli twaɪs ˈjuʒəwəli bɪˈfɔr ðə bʊˈfeɪ ˈoʊpənz./
dialogue.zh: 只來兩次，都在開餐之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, my bag touched your chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri maɪ bæɡ tʌtʃt jɔr tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的袋子碰到你的椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I am not using this side.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm aɪ æm nɑt ˈjuzɪŋ ðɪs saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 沒事，我這側沒有在用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sofa fits two, our group is three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈsoʊfə fɪts tu ˈaʊər ɡrup ɪz θriː./
dialogue.zh: 沙發坐兩個，我們三個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One may take the chair beside you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn meɪ teɪk ðə tʃɛr bɪˈsaɪd ju./
dialogue.zh: 第三位可以坐你旁邊那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three seats together, that was my worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri sits təˈɡɛðər ðæt wʌz maɪ ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 三個位子能連著，這是我擔心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are set, I marked the map for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr sɛt aɪ mɑrkt ðə mæp fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 都好了，我在地圖上幫你圈起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marked on the map, how helpful that is.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑrkt ɑn ðə mæp haʊ ˈhɛlpfʊl ðæt ɪz./
dialogue.zh: 標在地圖上，真是有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do it for tired guests often.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪt fɔr ˈtaɪərd ɡɛsts ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 我們常替累壞的旅客這樣做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife has been standing for hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf hæz bɪn ˈstændɪŋ fɔr ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 我太太已經站了好幾個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She may have the chair with the wheels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi meɪ hæv ðə tʃɛr wɪð ðə wilz./
dialogue.zh: 她可以坐那張有輪子的椅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wheels help her back, she likes that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wilz hɛlp hɜr bæk ʃi laɪks ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 有輪子對她背好，她喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll it to the lamp, the light is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ɪt tu ðə læmp ðə laɪt ɪz sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 推到燈邊，那裡的燈光柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the wire hangs across the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðə ˈwaɪər hæŋz əˈkrɔs ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 小心，有一條線跨在地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I taped it down, you are safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ teɪpt ɪt daʊn ju ɑr seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 我用膠帶貼好了，不會絆到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, no tripping in the dark later.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs noʊ ˈtrɪpɪŋ ɪn ðə dɑrk ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 很好，晚點天黑也不會絆倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lights go low at nine sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts ɡoʊ loʊ æt naɪn ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 九點整燈光會轉暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is our boarding time, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪz ˈaʊər ˈbɔrdɪŋ taɪm ˈæktʃuəli./
dialogue.zh: 九點其實是我們的登機時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep your phone sound on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip jɔr foʊn saʊnd ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 那別把手機的聲音關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sound on, it is right here in hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊnd ɑn ɪt ɪz raɪt hɪr ɪn hænd./
dialogue.zh: 聲音開著，手機就在我手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, your table is the calmest one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd jɔr ˈteɪbəl ɪz ðə ˈkɑlmɪst wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 很好，你那桌是最安靜的一桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We got lucky after all this standing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡɑt ˈlʌki ˈæftər ɔl ðɪs ˈstændɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 站了這麼久，運氣還不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standing is the worst part of travel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ ɪz ðə wɜrst pɑrt ʌv ˈtrævəl./
dialogue.zh: 站著往往是旅途中最累的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do all lounges fill up this late?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɔl ˈlaʊndʒɪz fɪl ʌp ðɪs leɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 每間貴賓室都很晚還這麼滿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the last hour is always packed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə læst ˈaʊər ɪz ˈɔlweɪz pækt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，最後一小時總是擠滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Packed, but we still found a place.
dialogue.phonetic: /pækt bʌt wi stɪl faʊnd ə pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 很擠，但我們還是找到位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the trick of lounge life.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə trɪk ʌv laʊndʒ laɪf./
dialogue.zh: 這就是貴賓室的門道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, is the window seat free?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ɪz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ sit fri?/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，靠窗的位子空著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For ten minutes, then a guest returns.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn ə ɡɛst rɪˈtɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 能坐十分鐘，之後客人要回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten is enough, she just needs a rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪz ɪˈnʌf ʃi dʒʌst nidz ə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘夠了，她只要休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her cup can sit on the round top.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr kʌp kæn sɪt ɑn ðə raʊnd tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 她的杯子可以放小圓桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room is warmer than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum ɪz ˈwɔrmər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 裡面比我想像中溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cool it down after the dinner rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kul ɪt daʊn ˈæftər ðə ˈdɪnər rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 晚餐人潮過後我們會調涼一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner rush means the food line, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪnər rʌʃ minz ðə fud laɪn raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 晚餐人潮就是指取餐的隊伍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the line moves fast after eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə laɪn muvz fæst ˈæftər eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 是的，八點之後隊伍走得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, we will eat before the screens change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi wɪl it bɪˈfɔr ðə skrinz tʃeɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我們趁螢幕變動前先吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat slow, your flight is on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /it sloʊ jɔr flaɪt ɪz ɑn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃，你的班機準時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On time is the best news tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn taɪm ɪz ðə bɛst nuz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 準時就是今晚最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy your sofa, you earned those seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔr ˈsoʊfə ju ɜrnd ðoʊz sits./
dialogue.zh: 好好坐你的沙發，這位子你們當之無愧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We did stand a very long while.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd stænd ə ˈvɛri lɔŋ waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我們確實站了非常久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a water for the waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə ˈwɔtər fɔr ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這瓶水慰勞你們的等待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You held our bags while we waited.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hɛld ˈaʊər bæɡz waɪl wi ˈweɪtɪd./
dialogue.zh: 你還幫忙顧著我們的行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is my job, sit and relax now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb sɪt ænd rɪˈlæks naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這是我該做的，坐下來休息吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The buffet sign is lit up now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊˈfeɪ saɪn ɪz lɪt ʌp naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 自助餐台的燈亮起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hot food starts at six fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɑt fud stɑrts æt sɪks fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 熱食六點十五分才開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is still warm on the line?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz stɪl wɔrm ɑn ðə laɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 取餐線上還有什麼是熱的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noodle bowls and the tomato soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnudəl boʊlz ænd ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ sup./
dialogue.zh: 有麵碗，還有番茄湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noodles at this hour, that is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnudəlz æt ðɪs ˈaʊər ðæt ɪz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 這個點還有麵，真不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cook stays till the tray is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʊk steɪz tɪl ðə treɪ ɪz ˈɛmpi./
dialogue.zh: 廚師會待到那一盤清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is left on that tray?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz lɛft ɑn ðæt treɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那一盤還剩多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half, and it lasts one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt hæf ænd ɪt læsts wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 大約剩一半，撐得了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour is plenty for two bowls.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔr tu boʊlz./
dialogue.zh: 一小時夠我們吃兩碗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the rice under the small lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə raɪs ˈʌndər ðə smɔl læmp./
dialogue.zh: 米飯在小燈下面那一鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the lamp, is that the fried rice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə læmp ɪz ðæt ðə fraɪd raɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 燈下那個是炒飯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with egg and green onion.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɪð ɛɡ ænd ɡrin ˈʌnjən./
dialogue.zh: 是的，裡面有蛋和蔥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green onion, perfect for my soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ˈʌnjən ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr maɪ sup./
dialogue.zh: 有蔥，我的湯剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The soup pot is on the left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sup pɑt ɪz ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 湯鍋在左手邊那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left side, got it. Any salad?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft saɪd ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛni ˈsæləd?/
dialogue.zh: 左邊知道了。有沙拉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a long bar with ten fresh bowls.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə lɔŋ bɑr wɪð tɛn frɛʃ boʊlz./
dialogue.zh: 有，一整排十碗新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten fresh bowls, we like that a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn frɛʃ boʊlz wi laɪk ðæt ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 十碗新鮮的，我們很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dressing is in the tiny bottles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdrɛsɪŋ ɪz ɪn ðə ˈtaɪni ˈbɑtəlz./
dialogue.zh: 醬料在那些小瓶子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny bottles, or the big glass one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni ˈbɑtəlz ɔr ðə bɪɡ ɡlæs wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 小瓶的，還是大的玻璃罐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, the big one has the sesame.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ðə bɪɡ wʌn hæz ðə ˈsɛsəmi./
dialogue.zh: 兩種都有，大罐是芝麻醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sesame is my wife's favorite taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛsəmi ɪz maɪ waɪfs ˈfeɪvərɪt teɪst./
dialogue.zh: 芝麻是我太太最愛的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then fill a small bowl for her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn fɪl ə smɔl boʊl fɔr hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 那先幫她裝一小碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they still make eggs to order?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ stɪl meɪk ɛɡz tu ˈɔrdər?/
dialogue.zh: 他們還現做蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two eggs, until a quarter past seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ɛɡz ʌnˈtɪl ə ˈkwɔrtər pæst ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 有，七點一刻前都現做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven fifteen, that is tight for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən fɪfˈtin ðæt ɪz taɪt fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 七點十五，對我們有點趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may ask the cook to wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ æsk ðə kʊk tu weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你可以請廚師等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask a cook to wait, I like that idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ə kʊk tu weɪt aɪ laɪk ðæt aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 請廚師等一下，這主意真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He hears me, I will walk over now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hɪrz mi aɪ wɪl wɔk ˈoʊvər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他聽得到的，我現在過去說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What bread is left on the shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt brɛd ɪz lɛft ɑn ðə ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 架子上還剩下什麼麵包？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the dark rye and plain rolls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə dɑrk raɪ ænd pleɪn roʊlz./
dialogue.zh: 只剩黑麥麵包和圓麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plain rolls are soft enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn roʊlz ɑr sɔft ɪˈnʌf fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 圓麵包對我來說夠軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter is in the small silver cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌtər ɪz ɪn ðə smɔl ˈsɪlvər kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 奶油在那個小銀杯裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The silver cup, and jam as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪlvər kʌp ænd dʒæm æz wɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 銀杯旁也有果醬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two jars, strawberry and bitter orange.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dʒɑrz ˈstrɔˌbɛri ænd ˈbɪtər ˈɔrɪndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 兩罐，草莓和苦橙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bitter orange on bread is the best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪtər ˈɔrɪndʒ ɑn brɛd ɪz ðə bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 苦橙醬抹麵包最好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the last jar, new ones come late.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə læst dʒɑr nuː wʌnz kʌm leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 拿最後那罐，新的晚點才補。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee machines are on the far wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi məˈʃinz ɑr ɑn ðə fɑr wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡機在最那邊的牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the tea box is beside them.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə ti bɑks ɪz bɪˈsaɪd ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 對，茶葉盒就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tea is good for sleeping soon?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ti ɪz ɡʊd fɔr ˈslipɪŋ sun?/
dialogue.zh: 哪種茶適合馬上要睡的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plain green, no mint at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪn ɡrin noʊ mɪnt æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 純綠茶，完全沒薄荷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No mint is fine, I like it plain.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɪnt ɪz faɪn aɪ laɪk ɪt pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 沒薄荷也好，我喜歡原味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cups are stacked under the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌps ɑr stækt ˈʌndər ðə ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 杯子都疊在架子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stacked cups, and where are the lids?
dialogue.phonetic: /stækt kʌps ænd wɛr ɑr ðə lɪdz?/
dialogue.zh: 疊好的杯子，那杯蓋在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the box by the hot water tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə bɑks baɪ ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər tæp./
dialogue.zh: 在熱水龍頭旁的盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot water tap, good, my wife wants tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ˈwɔtər tæp ɡʊd maɪ waɪf wɑnts ti./
dialogue.zh: 有熱水龍頭，我太太想喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She may ask us for a paper cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi meɪ æsk ʌs fɔr ə ˈpeɪpər kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 她可以跟我們拿紙杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit table, is it near the juice?
dialogue.phonetic: /frut ˈteɪbəl ɪz ɪt nɪr ðə dʒus?/
dialogue.zh: 水果台在果汁旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cut melon and whole apples.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kʌt ˈmɛlən ænd hoʊl ˈæpəlz./
dialogue.zh: 有的，切好的瓜和整顆蘋果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut melon at night is always wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ˈmɛlən æt naɪt ɪz ˈɔlweɪz wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 晚上的切瓜總是水水的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the dry ones on the top row.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə draɪ wʌnz ɑn ðə tɑp roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 拿最上面那排比較乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Top row, and juice is which flavor?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp roʊ ænd dʒus ɪz wɪtʃ ˈfleɪvər?/
dialogue.zh: 上排。果汁是什麼口味？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Orange, apple, and grapefruit juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrɪndʒ ˈæpəl ænd ˈɡreɪpˌfrut dʒus./
dialogue.zh: 柳橙、蘋果，還有葡萄柚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grapefruit is too bitter for our boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡreɪpˌfrut ɪz tu ˈbɪtər fɔr ˈaʊər bɔɪ./
dialogue.zh: 葡萄柚對我們家男孩太苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him the apple, it is mild.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hɪm ði ˈæpəl ɪt ɪz maɪld./
dialogue.zh: 給他蘋果汁，那個溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nuts or yogurt on that small shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌts ɔr ˈjoʊɡərt ɑn ðæt smɔl ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 小架子有堅果或優格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, in little cups with a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɪn ˈlɪtəl kʌps wɪð ə spun./
dialogue.zh: 都有，小杯裝好附湯匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A spoon, good, and where is the salt?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spun ɡʊd ænd wɛr ɪz ðə sɔlt?/
dialogue.zh: 有湯匙。鹽在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the rack by the noodle pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ræk baɪ ðə ˈnudəl pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 在麵鍋旁邊的小架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anything here very spicy hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛniθɪŋ hɪr ˈvɛri ˈspaɪsi hɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有什麼很辣的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The noodle sauce, ask for no chili.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnudəl sɔs æsk fɔr noʊ ˈtʃɪli./
dialogue.zh: 麵的醬辣，請廚師別放辣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No chili for the boy, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtʃɪli fɔr ðə bɔɪ pliz./
dialogue.zh: 小朋友那份不要辣，麻煩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell him, he listens well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛl hɪm hi ˈlɪsənz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我會跟他說，他都很配合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peanuts are in the salad, are they?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpiːnəts ɑr ɪn ðə ˈsæləd ɑr ðeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 沙拉裡面有花生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one jar of crushed peanuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn dʒɑr ʌv krʌʃt ˈpiːnəts./
dialogue.zh: 有，一罐碎花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our boy cannot have peanuts at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər bɔɪ ˈkænɑt hæv ˈpiːnəts æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子完全不能吃花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip that jar, I will mark it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn skɪp ðæt dʒɑr aɪ wɪl mɑrk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那別碰那罐，我幫你做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mark would help a lot here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mɑrk wʊd hɛlp ə lɑt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 有個記號在這裡很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forks and spoons at the end, wrapped.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrks ænd spunz æt ði ɛnd ræpt./
dialogue.zh: 餐具在最末端，都包好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrapped forks, nice, and paper napkins?
dialogue.phonetic: /ræpt fɔrks naɪs ænd ˈpeɪpər ˈnæpkɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 包好的叉子，那紙巾呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beside the bread, in a flat box.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈsaɪd ðə brɛd ɪn ə flæt bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 在麵包旁邊的扁盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat box, and are plates there too?
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt bɑks ænd ɑr pleɪts ðɛr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 扁盒子。盤子也在那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sizes, small for soup, big for food.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsaɪzɪz smɔl fɔr sup bɪɡ fɔr fud./
dialogue.zh: 兩種尺寸，小的裝湯大的裝餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big plate is heavy in my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ pleɪt ɪz ˈhɛvi ɪn maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 大盤子拿在手裡有點重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then carry one thing at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkæri wʌn θɪŋ æt ə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那就一次只拿一樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife carried four plates yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf ˈkærid fɔr pleɪts ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我太太昨天端了四盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is strong, but do not try here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz strɔŋ bʌt du nɑt traɪ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 她有力氣，但在這裡別試著端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor here is shiny, I know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr hɪr ɪz ˈʃaɪni aɪ noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的地板很亮，我知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, staff walk fast with big trays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli stæf wɔk fæst wɪð bɪɡ treɪz./
dialogue.zh: 就是，人員端大盤走得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I warm my rice a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ wɔrm maɪ raɪs ə ˈlɪtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 我能把米飯稍微熱一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the small oven is by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə smɔl ˈʌvən ɪz baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，小烤箱就在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the door, and it takes how long?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔr ænd ɪt teɪks haʊ lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 在門邊。要熱多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One minute, press one button on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɪnɪt prɛs wʌn ˈbʌtən ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 一分鐘，按上面那個按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One button, that is easy enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbʌtən ðæt ɪz ˈizi ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 一個按鈕，夠簡單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it rest two seconds, then take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt rɛst tu ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn teɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 讓它靜兩秒再拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar for coffee is where, may I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡər fɔr ˈkɔfi ɪz wɛr meɪ aɪ æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 請問咖啡的糖擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three kinds, white, brown, and none.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kaɪndz waɪt braʊn ænd nʌn./
dialogue.zh: 三種：白糖、黑糖，不加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown sugar, that smells like home.
dialogue.phonetic: /braʊn ˈʃʊɡər ðæt smɛlz laɪk hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 黑糖聞起來有家的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We get it from a shop downtown.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡɛt ɪt frʌm ə ʃɑp daʊnˈtaʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我們從市區一家小店進的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Downtown shop, small detail, I like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊnˈtaʊn ʃɑp smɔl dɪˈteɪl aɪ laɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 市區小店，小細節我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small details fill a long trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl dɪˈteɪlz fɪl ə lɔŋ trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 小細節能填滿漫長旅途。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dessert time, is the ice cream on?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈzɜrt taɪm ɪz ði aɪs krim ɑn?/
dialogue.zh: 吃甜點了，冰淇淋有開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three flavors in the cold case.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs θri ˈfleɪvərz ɪn ðə koʊld keɪs./
dialogue.zh: 有，冷櫃裡三種口味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold case, and the vanilla is which one?
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld keɪs ænd ðə vəˈnɪlə ɪz wɪtʃ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 冷櫃裡，香草是哪一格？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left tub, behind the chocolate one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft tʌb bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈtʃɑklət wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 左邊那桶，在巧克力後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice cream at this hour is bold.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪs krim æt ðɪs ˈaʊər ɪz boʊld./
dialogue.zh: 這個時間吃冰淇淋真大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two scoops, then it is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu skups ðɛn ɪt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 只挖兩球就沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two scoops for the boy, one for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu skups fɔr ðə bɔɪ wʌn fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 男孩兩球，我自己一球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot food stops at nine o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt fud stɑps æt naɪn əˈklɑk./
dialogue.zh: 熱食九點就停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock, we still have time.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn əˈklɑk wi stɪl hæv taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 九點，我們還有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sit, your table is still the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɪt jɔr ˈteɪbəl ɪz stɪl ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那就坐，你的位子還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shower slot is at seven, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃaʊər slɑt ɪz æt ˈsɛvən raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的淋浴時段是七點，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, room five, the towel is inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rum faɪv ðə ˈtaʊəl ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 對，五號房，毛巾在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room five, and do I bring a robe?
dialogue.phonetic: /rum faɪv ænd du aɪ brɪŋ ə roʊb?/
dialogue.zh: 五號房，那我要自己帶浴袍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Robes hang on the hook by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊbz hæŋ ɑn ðə hʊk baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 浴袍就掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the hook, good, I saw two there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə hʊk ɡʊd aɪ sɔ tu ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 掛鉤上，我剛才看到兩件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is clean, the other is being washed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪz klin ði ˈʌðər ɪz ˈbiɪŋ wɑʃt./
dialogue.zh: 一件是乾淨的，另一件在洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which robe size fits a tall man?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ roʊb saɪz fɪts ə tɔl mæn?/
dialogue.zh: 哪件浴袍適合高個子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray one, it is the largest here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡreɪ wʌn ɪt ɪz ðə ˈlɑrdʒɪst hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 灰色那件，是這裡最大號的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray it is, and the key for the locker?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ ɪt ɪz ænd ðə ki fɔr ðə ˈlɑkər?/
dialogue.zh: 就灰色。置物櫃的鑰匙呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This plastic tag, number twelve on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈplæstɪk tæɡ ˈnʌmbər twɛlv ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這個塑膠牌，上面寫十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve, that locker is next to showers?
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ðæt ˈlɑkər ɪz nɛkst tu ˈʃaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 十二號，那個櫃就在淋浴間旁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the third row on your right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə θɜrd roʊ ɑn jɔr raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，你右邊第三排那列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third row, and how long can I use it?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd roʊ ænd haʊ lɔŋ kæn aɪ juz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 第三排。我能用多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes, then the next guest waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn ðə nɛkst ɡɛst weɪts./
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，下一位會在外面等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen is short, but enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ɪz ʃɔrt bʌt ɪˈnʌf fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘雖短，對我夠用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside you can lock the door, no fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ju kæn lɑk ðə dɔr noʊ fɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在裡面可以反鎖，不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock it, fine, and is the water hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑk ɪt faɪn ænd ɪz ðə ˈwɔtər hɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 鎖好。水是熱的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very hot, give it ten seconds first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri hɑt ɡɪv ɪt tɛn ˈsɛkəndz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 很熱，先放十秒再站進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten seconds, and the handle turns which way?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ænd ðə ˈhændəl tɜrnz wɪtʃ weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 十秒。把手要往哪邊轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left for hot, right for cold water.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft fɔr hɑt raɪt fɔr koʊld ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 左邊熱水，右邊是冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left for hot, good, I like simple signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft fɔr hɑt ɡʊd aɪ laɪk ˈsɪmpəl saɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 左熱右冷，我喜歡簡單的標示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some rooms use red and blue dots.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm rumz juz rɛd ænd blu dɑts./
dialogue.zh: 有幾間是用紅色和藍色圓點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red and blue, that is clearer for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd ænd blu ðæt ɪz ˈklɪrər fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 紅藍對比，我看起來更清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shower head pulls down a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈʃaʊər hɛd pʊlz daʊn ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 花灑頭能往下拉一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pulls down, good, I do not reach high.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊlz daʊn ɡʊd aɪ du nɑt ritʃ haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 能拉下來，我伸手不夠高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also turns toward the wall side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ tɜrnz təˈwɔrd ðə wɔl saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 它也能轉向靠牆那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gel and shampoo are on the small shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɛl ænd ʃæmˈpu ɑr ɑn ðə smɔl ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 沐浴乳和洗髮精在小架上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two bottles, both smell like lemon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ˈbɑtəlz boʊθ smɛl laɪk ˈlɛmən./
dialogue.zh: 是的，兩瓶都是檸檬味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lemon smell wakes me up a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛmən smɛl weɪks mi ʌp ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 檸檬味讓我清醒了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is conditioner in the flat one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz kənˈdɪʃənər ɪn ðə flæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 扁的那瓶是護髮乳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Conditioner, nice, my hair gets rough.
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈdɪʃənər naɪs maɪ hɛr ɡɛts rʌf./
dialogue.zh: 有護髮乳，我頭髮都很粗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plane air does that to every head.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ɛr dʌz ðæt tu ˈɛvri hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 機艙的空氣對誰都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plane air, that explains my dry skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ɛr ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz maɪ draɪ skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 機艙空氣，難怪我皮膚這麼乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lotion is on the shelf by the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊʃən ɪz ɑn ðə ʃɛlf baɪ ðə ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 潤膚乳在鏡子旁的架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the mirror, is it a big bottle?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə ˈmɪrər ɪz ɪt ə bɪɡ ˈbɑtəl?/
dialogue.zh: 鏡子旁那個，是大瓶的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small pump, but we refill it often.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl pʌmp bʌt wi ˈrifɪl ɪt ˈɔfən./
dialogue.zh: 小壓瓶，但我們常常補滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mirror fogs after one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪrər fɔɡz ˈæftər wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鏡子一分鐘就起霧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it, the cloth is on the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt ðə klɔθ ɪz ɑn ðə reɪl./
dialogue.zh: 擦一下，布掛在桿子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloth on the rail, you think of all.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔθ ɑn ðə reɪl ju θɪŋk ʌv ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 布掛在桿上，你們什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We redo this room many times a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈridu ðɪs rum ˈmɛni taɪmz ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這間房一天要重新整理很多次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Many times, is the floor drying fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni taɪmz ɪz ðə flɔr ˈdraɪɪŋ fæst?/
dialogue.zh: 很多次。地板乾得快嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We mop it after each guest, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi mɑp ɪt ˈæftər itʃ ɡɛst ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 每位客人用完我們都拖過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mopped floor, good, my socks are wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑpt flɔr ɡʊd maɪ sɑks ɑr wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 拖過的地板。我襪子都濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slippers wait in a basket by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpərz weɪt ɪn ə ˈbæskɪt baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋放在門邊的籃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A basket of slippers, that is kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbæskɪt ʌv ˈslɪpərz ðæt ɪz kaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 一籃拖鞋，真貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a pair, they are for one use.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə pɛr ðeɪ ɑr fɔr wʌn juz./
dialogue.zh: 拿一雙，那是一次性的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One use, then I keep them on board.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn juz ðɛn aɪ kip ðɛm ɑn bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 穿一次，然後在飛機上繼續穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice plan, the plane floor is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs plæn ðə pleɪn flɔr ɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 好打算，機艙地板很涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold floors, my wife knows that well.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld flɔrz maɪ waɪf noʊz ðæt wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 冷地板，我太太最懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her the second pair, we have extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɜr ðə ˈsɛkənd pɛr wi hæv ˈɛkstrə./
dialogue.zh: 幫她也拿一雙，我們有多的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hair dryer, is that under the sink?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛr ˈdraɪər ɪz ðæt ˈʌndər ðə sɪŋk?/
dialogue.zh: 吹風機在洗臉槽下面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in the drawer, next to the comb.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn ðə drɔr nɛkst tu ðə koʊm./
dialogue.zh: 對，在抽屜裡，梳子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In a drawer, clever, it stays out of water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə drɔr ˈklɛvər ɪt steɪz aʊt ʌv ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 放抽屜裡真聰明，不會淋到水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is strong too, two minutes and done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz strɔŋ tu tu ˈmɪnɪts ænd dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 風也很大，吹兩分鐘就乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes fits inside my fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts fɪts ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 吹兩分鐘，十五分鐘的額度夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You still have time for a slow coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju stɪl hæv taɪm fɔr ə sloʊ ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 你還有時間慢慢喝杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow coffee after a hot shower is best.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ˈkɔfi ˈæftər ə hɑt ˈʃaʊər ɪz bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 洗完熱水澡再慢慢喝咖啡最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine is warm, no line at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin ɪz wɔrm noʊ laɪn æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡機正熱，完全不用排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the hot water on in room five?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər ɑn ɪn rum faɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 五號房的熱水來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, one pipe is being fixed.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt wʌn paɪp ɪz ˈbiɪŋ fɪkst./
dialogue.zh: 還沒，有一條水管正在修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which room has hot water, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ rum hæz hɑt ˈwɔtər ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那哪間有熱水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room two and four, both are free.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum tu ænd fɔr boʊθ ɑr fri./
dialogue.zh: 二號和四號，兩間都空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two or four, I will take the four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɔr fɔr aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 二或四，我要用四號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, the four has a big head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs ðə fɔr hæz ə bɪɡ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 選得好，四號的花灑很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big head, wide water, that is my style.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ hɛd waɪd ˈwɔtər ðæt ɪz maɪ staɪl./
dialogue.zh: 大水柱，那就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes and you will feel fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ænd ju wɪl fil frɛʃ./
dialogue.zh: 沖十分鐘你就會神清氣爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I slept badly, so a shower helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slɛpt ˈbædli soʊ ə ˈʃaʊər hɛlps./
dialogue.zh: 我昨晚沒睡好，洗澡有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long flights do that to most people.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ flaɪts du ðæt tu moʊst ˈpipəl./
dialogue.zh: 長程航班對誰都折騰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Most people, but I will sleep on board.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl bʌt aɪ wɪl slip ɑn bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 多數人如此，我打算在機上補眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hot shower makes that sleep deeper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hɑt ˈʃaʊər meɪks ðæt slip ˈdipər./
dialogue.zh: 洗個熱水澡那一覺會睡更深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deeper sleep, that is my whole plan here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdipər slip ðæt ɪz maɪ hoʊl plæn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 睡更深，就是我在這兒的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room four is ready, the door is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum fɔr ɪz ˈrɛdi ðə dɔr ɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 四號準備好了，門開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open door, and my bag stays outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən dɔr ænd maɪ bæɡ steɪz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 門開著，我的袋子放外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang it on the hook inside the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ɪt ɑn ðə hʊk ɪnˈsaɪd ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 掛在房間裡面的掛鉤上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, good. Is there a small stool?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ɡʊd ɪz ðɛr ə smɔl stul?/
dialogue.zh: 放裡面好。有小凳子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one plastic seat near the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈplæstɪk sit nɪr ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 有，牆邊一個塑膠矮凳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A seat, my knees thank you for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sit maɪ niz θæŋk ju fɔr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 有凳子坐，我的膝蓋會感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit and let the warm water do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ænd lɛt ðə wɔrm ˈwɔtər du ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 坐著讓熱水慢慢處理就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wash the floor after using it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɑʃ ðə flɔr ˈæftər ˈjuzɪŋ ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 用完我要把地板沖一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, our staff checks every room.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid ˈaʊər stæf tʃɛks ˈɛvri rum./
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們人員每間都檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every room, that is a lot of work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri rum ðæt ɪz ə lɑt ʌv wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 每間都查，那是不少工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night shifts are quiet, we fill them.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ʃɪfts ɑr ˈkwaɪət wi fɪl ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 夜班很閒，我們用整理填時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet nights, and someone still showers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət naɪts ænd ˈsʌmwʌn stɪl ˈʃaʊərz?/
dialogue.zh: 安靜的夜裡還有人洗澡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few, mostly guests with late flights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fju ˈmoʊstli ɡɛsts wɪð leɪt flaɪts./
dialogue.zh: 有幾個，大多是晚班機的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late flights, that is exactly us.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt flaɪts ðæt ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 晚班機，說的正是我們這一家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no rushing, you have ten minutes left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ˈrʌʃɪŋ ju hæv tɛn ˈmɪnɪts lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 那就別急，你還有十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten more, and a bell will remind me?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr ænd ə bɛl wɪl rɪˈmaɪnd mi?/
dialogue.zh: 還十分鐘，會有鈴聲提醒我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A soft chime, it never rings loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft tʃaɪm ɪt ˈnɛvər rɪŋz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 是輕輕一聲，從不大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft is good, I hate sudden noise.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ɪz ɡʊd aɪ heɪt ˈsʌdən nɔɪz./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕的剛好，我討厭突然的吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody wants noise in a sleep hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi wɑnts nɔɪz ɪn ə slip ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 想睡的一小時裡沒人愛吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hair is half dry, the mirror is clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛr ɪz hæf draɪ ðə ˈmɪrər ɪz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 頭髮半乾，鏡子也擦清了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look awake now, that was the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk əˈweɪk naʊ ðæt wʌz ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 你現在看著清醒了，重點就是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awake for now, but soon I will nod.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪk fɔr naʊ bʌt sun aɪ wɪl nɑd./
dialogue.zh: 現在是醒的，但一下就會打瞌睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The quiet room is ready when you are.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkwaɪət rum ɪz ˈrɛdi wɛn ju ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 安靜室隨時可以去，已經備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet room, how far from this corridor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət rum haʊ fɑr frʌm ðɪs kəˈrɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 安靜室離這條走廊多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty steps, under the departure screens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti stɛps ˈʌndər ðə dɪˈpɑrtʃər skrinz./
dialogue.zh: 五十步，在班次螢幕下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Screens above the way, easy to find.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrinz əˈbʌv ðə weɪ ˈizi tu faɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 頭上有螢幕，很好找到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put the wet towel in the red bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pʊt ðə wɛt ˈtaʊəl ɪn ðə rɛd bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，濕毛巾丟進紅色那桶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red bin, done, and my tag is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd bɪn dʌn ænd maɪ tæɡ ɪz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 丟進紅桶了，牌子在我手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it till you board, then drop it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt tɪl ju bɔrd ðɛn drɑp ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 登機前先收著，回來再投進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is the quiet room, is it?
