dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈkwaɪət rum ɪz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡就是安靜室，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, doors close softly behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dɔrz kloʊz ˈsɔftli bɪˈhaɪnd ju./
dialogue.zh: 是的，門會在您身後輕聲關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phones, no calls, and no food smells?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ foʊnz noʊ kɔlz ænd noʊ fud smɛlz?/
dialogue.zh: 不能講手機、不能通話、不能帶食物？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, coffee cups stay outside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈkɔfi kʌps steɪ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 對，咖啡杯要留在門外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, okay, my bag has a cookie.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd oʊˈkeɪ maɪ bæɡ hæz ə ˈkʊki./
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我袋子裡還有餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please eat it in the dining area.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz it it ɪn ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ ˈɛriə./
dialogue.zh: 請到用餐區吃完再進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights here are very low already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts hɪr ɑr ˈvɛri loʊ ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的燈光已經很暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We set them at night level after eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛt ðɛm æt naɪt ˈlɛvəl ˈæftər eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 八點以後我們把燈調到夜間亮度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night level, perfect for tired eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈlɛvəl ˈpɜrfɪkt fɔr ˈtaɪərd aɪz./
dialogue.zh: 夜間亮度，對疲累的眼睛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chairs also lean back slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛrz ˈɔlsoʊ lin bæk ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 椅子也能緩緩往後傾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lean back, and the head rest follows?
dialogue.phonetic: /lin bæk ænd ði hɛd rɛst ˈfɑloʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 往後傾，頭枕會跟著動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it moves with your neck, no push.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt muvz wɪð jɔr nɛk noʊ pʊʃ./
dialogue.zh: 會，它跟著頸部走，不用推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blankets, are they in that wooden box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈblæŋkɪts ɑr ðeɪ ɪn ðæt ˈwʊdən bɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 毛毯在那個木箱裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, folded, the top shelf has clean ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈfoʊldɪd ðə tɑp ʃɛlf hæz klin wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 對，都摺好了，上層是乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Folded blankets, that feels like home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldɪd ˈblæŋkɪts ðæt filz laɪk hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 摺好的毛毯，有家的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, the room gets cool at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu ðə rum ɡɛts kuːl æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 拿兩條吧，夜裡這間會變涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blankets for my wife and me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈblæŋkɪts fɔr maɪ waɪf ænd mi./
dialogue.zh: 兩條，一條給我一條給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, and the small pillow is hers too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ænd ðə smɔl ˈpɪloʊ ɪz hɜrz tu./
dialogue.zh: 給您，小抱枕也是她的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small pillow, good, and eye masks?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈpɪloʊ ɡʊd ænd aɪ mæskz?/
dialogue.zh: 小抱枕不錯。有眼罩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the basket by the second chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈbæskɪt baɪ ðə ˈsɛkənd tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 在第二張椅子旁的籃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eye masks are soft, or tight on the face?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ mæskz ɑr sɔft ɔr taɪt ɑn ðə feɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 眼罩是鬆的，還是緊貼臉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose, with a small band behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus wɪð ə smɔl bænd bɪˈhaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 鬆鬆的，後面一條小帶子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A band behind, that will not hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bænd bɪˈhaɪnd ðæt wɪl nɑt hɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 後面的帶子，應該不會痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, some guests sleep in them twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər sʌm ɡɛsts slip ɪn ðɛm twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 不會痛，有人一晚用兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Earplugs too, are those in the basket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈirˌplʌɡz tu ɑr ðoʊz ɪn ðə ˈbæskɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 耳塞也在籃子裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, plugs are at the desk, ask kindly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ plʌɡz ɑr æt ðə dɛsk æsk ˈkaɪndli./
dialogue.zh: 耳塞在工作台，跟人員要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the desk kindly, got that.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə dɛsk ˈkaɪndli ɡɑt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 客氣地跟人員要，記得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a pair, foam, very small.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə pɛr foʊm ˈvɛri smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 這是一雙泡棉的，很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small foam plugs, they block the hum?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl foʊm plʌɡz ðeɪ blɑk ðə hʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 小泡棉耳塞能擋掉嗡嗡聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, the air sound stays very soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ði ɛr saʊnd steɪz ˈvɛri sɔft./
dialogue.zh: 大半擋掉，空調聲會變很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft air sound, that is what I need.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ɛr saʊnd ðæt ɪz wʌt aɪ nid./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕的空調聲，正是我要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may roll the sign on your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ roʊl ðə saɪn ɑn jɔr dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 你可以把門上的牌子轉過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sign on the door, what does it say?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪn ɑn ðə dɔr wʌt dʌz ɪt seɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 門上的牌子寫了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Resting, please do not wake me yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛstɪŋ pliːz du nɑt weɪk mi jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著休息中，請先別叫醒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like those few words on the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðoʊz fju wɜrdz ɑn ðə saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡牌子上那幾個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it out, staff will pass by slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt aʊt stæf wɪl pæs baɪ ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 把牌子轉出來，人員會走慢些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turned it out. My phone is silent.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrnd ɪt aʊt maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈsaɪlənt./
dialogue.zh: 轉好了，我手機完全無聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it face down, the screen glows.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt feɪs daʊn ðə skrin ɡloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕朝下放，它會自己發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Face down, yes, and a short alarm.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs daʊn jɛs ænd ə ʃɔrt əˈlɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 朝下放，再設一個短鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes is the lounge rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts ɪz ðə laʊndʒ rul./
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室規定是三十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes, then my neck can rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn maɪ nɛk kæn rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 三十分鐘，頸部能好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or take forty in the far corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr teɪk ˈfɔrti ɪn ðə fɑr ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 要到最裡面那角就能睡四十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty is deep sleep, I fear the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ɪz dip slip aɪ fir ðə klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘會睡太深，我怕過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We always knock softly at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɔlweɪz nɑk ˈsɔftli æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 時間到我們會輕輕敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Knock softly, that is a kind promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑk ˈsɔftli ðæt ɪz ə kaɪnd ˈprɑmɪs./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕敲門，這是貼心的承諾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do it fifty times every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪt ˈfɪfti taɪmz ˈɛvri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們每晚要這樣做五十次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty sleeps a night, this place is busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti slips ə naɪt ðɪs pleɪs ɪz ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 一晚五十覺，這裡真忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night is our day, most guests are tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ɪz ˈaʊr deɪ moʊst ɡɛsts ɑr ˈtaɪərd./
dialogue.zh: 夜裡就是我們的白天，客人都累。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Most are tired, my son fell asleep already.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ɑr ˈtaɪərd maɪ sʌn fɛl əˈslɪp ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 多數人都累，我兒子已經睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Children sleep well in these chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪldrən slip wɛl ɪn ðiz tʃɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 小孩在這些椅子上睡得特別好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In these chairs, with a blanket over him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðiz tʃɛrz wɪð ə ˈblæŋkɪt ˈoʊvər hɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 在這些椅子上，給他蓋條毛毯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will bring a light one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ə laɪt wʌn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，我現在拿一條薄的來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A light one, he kicks the thick ones off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə laɪt wʌn hi kɪks ðə θɪk wʌnz ɔf./
dialogue.zh: 薄的就好，厚的他會踢開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids, always warm feet and cold knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz ˈɔlweɪz wɔrm fit ænd koʊld niz./
dialogue.zh: 小孩都一樣，腳熱膝蓋涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm feet, cold knees, exactly my boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm fit koʊld niz ɪɡˈzæktli maɪ bɔɪ./
dialogue.zh: 腳熱膝蓋涼，正是我家男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set his alarm too, or he sleeps long.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt hɪz əˈlɑrm tu ɔr hi slips lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 也幫他設鬧鐘，不然會睡很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set his alarm, good thought, I forgot.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt hɪz əˈlɑrm ɡʊd θɔt aɪ fərˈɡɑt./
dialogue.zh: 幫他設鬧鐘，我差點忘記了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most parents forget, we wake them all.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpɛrənts fərˈɡɛt wi weɪk ðɛm ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 多數父母都會忘，我們會叫醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wake them all, what a job you have.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪk ðɛm ɔl wʌt ə dʒɑb ju hæv./
dialogue.zh: 叫醒每個人，你們的工作真特別。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like it, quiet people make easy guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ɪt ˈkwaɪət ˈpipəl meɪk ˈizi ɡɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這工作，安靜的人好照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my chair, do I tilt it first?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ tʃɛr du aɪ tɪlt ɪt fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 現在我的椅子，要先傾下去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half back is best for a light nap.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf bæk ɪz bɛst fɔr ə laɪt næp./
dialogue.zh: 倒一半最好，適合淺淺的小睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half back, and my shoes under the seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf bæk ænd maɪ ʃuz ˈʌndər ðə sit?/
dialogue.zh: 倒一半。鞋子放在座位下面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and pull the small foot plate up.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd pʊl ðə smɔl fʊt pleɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 對，再把小腳踏板拉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foot plate up, legs lifted, that is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊt pleɪt ʌp lɛɡz ˈlɪftɪd ðæt ɪz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 腳踏板拉起，腿抬高，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swollen feet sleep better when they are high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswoʊlən fit slip ˈbɛtər wɛn ðeɪ ɑr haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 腫了的腳抬高會睡得更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swollen, yes, after that long walk upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswoʊlən jɛs ˈæftər ðæt lɔŋ wɔk ˌʌpˈstɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 是腫了，剛才走樓梯走太久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lift is faster, next time use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪft ɪz ˈfæstər nɛkst taɪm juz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 電梯快多了，下次記得搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, I will remember that tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbər ðæt tɪp./
dialogue.zh: 下次我一定記得你這個提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We give many tips, you ask good things.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡiv ˈmɛni tɪps ju æsk ɡʊd θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 我們常講這些，你很會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathing slow, eyes closed, and then sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbriðɪŋ sloʊ aɪz kloʊzd ænd ðɛn slip./
dialogue.zh: 呼吸放慢，閉上眼，就睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not count minutes, just let it come.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt kaʊnt ˈmɪnɪts dʒʌst lɛt ɪt kʌm./
dialogue.zh: 別數著分鐘，讓睡意自己來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let it come, that is hard for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt kʌm ðæt ɪz hɑrd fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 讓它自己來，這對我有一點難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close your mask first, dark helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz jɔr mæsk fɜrst dɑrk hɛlps ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 先戴眼罩，黑暗很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mask on now, I cannot see my hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /mæsk ɑn naʊ aɪ ˈkænɑt si maɪ hændz./
dialogue.zh: 戴好了，我連自己的手都看不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, and the room stays dark all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd ðə rum steɪz dɑrk ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，這間房整晚都是暗的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already dark, and my plugs are in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi dɑrk ænd maɪ plʌɡz ɑr ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 本來就暗，耳塞我也塞好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you will hear nothing but your breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju wɪl hɪr ˈnʌθɪŋ bʌt jɔr brɛθ./
dialogue.zh: 那樣你只聽得見自己的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing but breath, I hope it is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ bʌt brɛθ aɪ hoʊp ɪt ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 只剩呼吸聲，希望真的安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, the door has a thick rubber seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə dɔr hæz ə θɪk ˈrʌbər sil./
dialogue.zh: 是的，門邊有厚厚的橡皮封條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thick seal, and no cart noise at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk sil ænd noʊ kɑrt nɔɪz æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 有封條，夜裡也沒有推車聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We park carts outside after the dinner rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pɑrk kɑrts ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈæftər ðə ˈdɪnər rʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 晚餐人潮後推車都停在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parked outside, then my nap is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑrkt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðɛn maɪ næp ɪz seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 停在外頭，我這小睡就安穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, I will check back at fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ aɪ wɪl tʃɛk bæk æt fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，十五分鐘時我會回來看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In fifteen, that is my halfway point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn fɪfˈtin ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈhæfˌweɪ pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，正好是我的一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I knock softly and say your flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ nɑk ˈsɔftli ænd seɪ jɔr flaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，我會輕敲門報你的航班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say my flight name, then I will rise.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ maɪ flaɪt neɪm ðɛn aɪ wɪl raɪz./
dialogue.zh: 報了航班名，我就會起身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow rise, the room may spin a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ raɪz ðə rum meɪ spɪn ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢起，房間會暈一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spin a bit, then water wakes me up.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɪn ə bɪt ðɛn ˈwɔtər weɪks mi ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 暈一下，喝口水就清醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cool water is by the reading lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kul ˈwɔtər ɪz baɪ ðə ˈridɪŋ læmp./
dialogue.zh: 涼水就放在閱讀燈旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the lamp, and paper cups too?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə læmp ænd ˈpeɪpər kʌps tu?/
dialogue.zh: 燈旁邊。也有紙杯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stack of them, take just one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stæk ʌv ðɛm teɪk dʒʌst wʌn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 疊在那裡，先拿一個就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cup, and my eyes feel less dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kʌp ænd maɪ aɪz fil lɛs draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一杯水，我的眼睛比較不乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two things, rest and one full cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu θɪŋz rɛst ænd wʌn fʊl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 只要兩樣，睡覺和一杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two small things, and I really fell asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu smɔl θɪŋz ænd aɪ ˈrɪli fɛl əˈslip./
dialogue.zh: 就這兩樣，我真的睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half an hour, you did it beautifully.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ən ˈaʊər ju dɪd ɪt ˈbjutəfəli./
dialogue.zh: 半小時，你睡得很安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half an hour, I feel like a person.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ən ˈaʊər aɪ fil laɪk ə ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 半小時，我覺得自己像個人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the point of a lounge nap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt ʌv ə laʊndʒ næp./
dialogue.zh: 這正是貴賓室小睡的目的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lounge nap, done. Where is my son now?
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊndʒ næp dʌn wɛr ɪz maɪ sʌn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 小睡結束，我兒子現在在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is asleep, two chairs down the row.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz əˈslip tu tʃɛrz daʊn ðə roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他睡著了，就在隔兩張椅的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screens hang above the doorway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrinz hæŋ əˈbʌv ðə ˈdɔrˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕掛在門口正上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look for your flight number there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lʊk fɔr jɔr flaɪt ˈnʌmbər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 對，在那上面找你的航班號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Row four shows our flight and gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ fɔr ʃoʊz ˈaʊər flaɪt ænd ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 第四列就是我們的班機和登機門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boarding at nine, gate B twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɔrdɪŋ æt naɪn ɡeɪt bi twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 九點登機，登機門 B12。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock, that is soon for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn əˈklɑk ðæt ɪz sun fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 九點整，對我們來說快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have one hour still, no worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hæv wʌn ˈaʊər stɪl noʊ ˈwɜri./
dialogue.zh: 你還有一小時，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The status says on time, in green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstætəs sɛz ɑn taɪm ɪn ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 狀態寫著準時，是綠色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green is good, amber means wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ɪz ɡʊd ˈæmbər minz weɪt ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 綠色就好，琥珀色是要等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What color is a delay on these screens?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈkʌlər ɪz ə dɪˈleɪ ɑn ðiz skrinz?/
dialogue.zh: 這些螢幕上，延誤是什麼顏色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red text, and the new time beside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd tɛkst ænd ðə nuː taɪm bɪˈsaɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 紅字，新時間就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The board just moved a row up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɔrd dʒʌst muvd ə roʊ ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 看板剛剛往上跳了一列。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It refreshes every two minutes here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rɪˈfrɛʃɪz ˈɛvri tu ˈmɪnɪts hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡每兩分鐘更新一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, so I should look again.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts soʊ aɪ ʃʊd lʊk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，那我該再看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand close, the small letters are clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd kloʊs ðə smɔl ˈlɛtərz ɑr klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 走近一點，小字也看得清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close enough now, oh, the gate changed.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊs ɪˈnʌf naʊ oʊ ðə ɡeɪt tʃeɪndʒd./
dialogue.zh: 夠近了。喔，登機門變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look, it says B seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk ɪt sɛz bi ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 我看看，上面寫的是 B7。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: B seven? That is far from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /bi ˈsɛvən ðæt ɪz fɑr frʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: B7？那離這裡很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, past the book store on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pæst ðə bʊk stɔr ɑn ðə raɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，過了書局，在右手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Past the book store? How far, ten minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə bʊk stɔr haʊ fɑr tɛn ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 過了書局？要走多久，十分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight minutes walking, five by cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈmɪnɪts ˈwɔkɪŋ faɪv baɪ kɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 走路八分鐘，推車五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cart? There is a cart inside here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrt ðɛr ɪz ə kɑrt ɪnˈsaɪd hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 推車？這裡面也有推車可以借？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a small tram for tired feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ə smɔl treɪm fɔr ˈtaɪərd fit./
dialogue.zh: 不是，是給走累人的小車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tram, that would help my wife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə træm ðæt wʊd hɛlp maɪ waɪf./
dialogue.zh: 小車，那對我太太有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs every fifteen minutes, by the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rʌnz ˈɛvri fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts baɪ ðə ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 每十五分鐘一班，在店面旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the shop, and does it stop at B?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə ʃɑp ænd dʌz ɪt stɑp æt bi?/
dialogue.zh: 在店面旁。它會停在 B 區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the B row is its last stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə bi roʊ ɪz ɪts læst stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 會，B 那一排是末站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Is there also a text alert?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɪz ðɛr ˈɔlsoʊ ə tɛkst əˈlɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 好。那也有文字訊息提醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your message will say the new gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jɔr ˈmɛsɪdʒ wɪl seɪ ðə nuː ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 會，訊息會寫新的登機門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is quiet, the alert will buzz.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈkwaɪət ði əˈlɜrt wɪl bʌz./
dialogue.zh: 我手機無聲，提醒會震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it in your pocket, not the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ɪn jɔr ˈpɑkɪt nɑt ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 放口袋裡，別塞進袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In my pocket, done. And the loud voice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt dʌn ænd ðə laʊd vɔɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 放口袋了。那廣播的聲音呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They call the gate change twice, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kɔl ðə ɡeɪt tʃeɪndʒ twaɪs ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 廣播會慢速念兩次變動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice is kind, this hall is noisy.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz kaɪnd ðɪs hɔl ɪz ˈnɔɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 念兩次真好，這大廳很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here the sound is soft on purpose.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðə saʊnd ɪz sɔft ɑn ˈpɜrpəs./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的聲音故意放得很輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft sound, so screens matter more here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft saʊnd soʊ skrinz ˈmætər mɔr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 聲音輕，所以螢幕更要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is why staff watch them too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt ɪz waɪ stæf wɑtʃ ðɛm tu./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以人員也一直盯著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Staff watch too, that makes me calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæf wɑtʃ tu ðæt meɪks mi kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 有人一起盯著，我就安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We check every ten minutes, all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi tʃɛk ˈɛvri tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們每十分鐘查一次，整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All day, and the board never lies?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl deɪ ænd ðə bɔrd ˈnɛvər laɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 整天。看板都不會出錯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely, but the voice can lag behind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli bʌt ðə vɔɪs kæn læɡ bɪˈhaɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 很少錯，但廣播會慢半拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lag behind, so the screen comes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /læɡ bɪˈhaɪnd soʊ ðə skrin kʌmz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 慢半拍，所以螢幕先報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, trust the board first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli jɛs trʌst ðə bɔrd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 大致是，先相信看板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Board first, then wait for the voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔrd fɜrst ðɛn weɪt fɔr ðə vɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 先看板上，然後等廣播。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, most guests only look at phones.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt moʊst ɡɛsts ˈoʊnli lʊk æt foʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，多數人只看手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phones show old news, the board is live.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz ʃoʊ oʊld nuz ðə bɔrd ɪz laɪv./
dialogue.zh: 手機是舊消息，看板即時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Live, yes, straight from the flight desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪv jɛs streɪt frʌm ðə flaɪt dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 即時的，直接來自航班台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The flight desk feeds the big screens?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flaɪt dɛsk fidz ðə bɪɡ skrinz?/
dialogue.zh: 航班台把資料送到大螢幕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one person, two monitors, all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn ˈpɜrsən tu ˈmɑnɪtərz ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 是的，一人兩螢幕，看整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two monitors sounds like a calm job.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɑnɪtərz saʊndz laɪk ə kɑm dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 兩台螢幕聽起來是很穩的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until a storm day, then it is wild.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈtɪl ə stɔrm deɪ ðɛn ɪt ɪz waɪld./
dialogue.zh: 直到颱風那天才會亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A storm would be just our luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɔrm wʊd bi dʒʌst ɑr lʌk./
dialogue.zh: 若是颱風天，剛好讓我們碰上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still, the sky is clear at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ðə skaɪ ɪz klɪr æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 不過家鄉那頭的天是晴的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son asks which row is our gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn æsks wɪtʃ roʊ ɪz ˈaʊər ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子問我們哪一列是哪個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point him to the row with your number.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt hɪm tu ðə roʊ wɪð jɔr ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 指給他看有你們號碼那一列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He found it, row four, gate B seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi faʊnd ɪt roʊ fɔr ɡeɪt bi ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 他找到了，第四列，B7 門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good kids read screens faster than us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɪdz rid skrinz ˈfæstər ðæn ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 懂事的小孩讀螢幕比我們快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Faster, true, my eyes need the mask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstər tru maɪ aɪz nid ðə mæsk./
dialogue.zh: 真的比較快，我眼睛需要眼罩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them now, the board will hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛm naʊ ðə bɔrd wɪl hoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 現在讓眼睛休息，看板會等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will hold, and what if it changes again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hoʊld ænd wʌt ɪf ɪt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 會等。如果它又變了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we text you, and I knock here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi tɛkst ju ænd aɪ nɑk hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那我們會傳訊息，我也來敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Knock here, in the quiet room, softly?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑk hɪr ɪn ðə ˈkwaɪət rum ˈsɔftli?/
dialogue.zh: 在安靜室裡敲門，會很輕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One light knock, that is our rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪt nɑk ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər rul./
dialogue.zh: 只輕輕敲一下，這是我們的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your rules are clear in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr rulz ɑr klɪr ɪn maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你們的規矩我都記在腦裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now watch the amber light again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ wɑtʃ ði ˈæmbər laɪt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在再看一次琥珀色那行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is amber now, not green at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈæmbər naʊ nɑt ɡrin æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 現在變琥珀色了，不再是綠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means delay, the new time will come.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz dɪˈleɪ ðə nuː taɪm wɪl kʌm./
dialogue.zh: 那是延誤，新時間一下就會跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delay, how long, do you guess?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈleɪ haʊ lɔŋ du ju ɡɛs?/
dialogue.zh: 延誤，你猜會延多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the board shows plus one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə bɔrd ʃoʊz plʌs wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 你看，看板多了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plus one hour, so boarding at ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌs wʌn ˈaʊər soʊ ˈbɔrdɪŋ æt tɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 多一小時，那十點登機？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten sharp, the screen says it plain.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛn ʃɑrp ðə skrin sɛz ɪt pleɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，十點整，螢幕寫得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten sharp, so we can stay longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ʃɑrp soʊ wi kæn steɪ ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 十點整，那我們能待更久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lounge stays open, no worry there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laʊndʒ steɪz ˈoʊpən noʊ ˈwɜri ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 貴賓室會開著，那邊不必擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worry, and my seat is still mine?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜri ænd maɪ sit ɪz stɪl maɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 不擔心了。我的位子還是我的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your table stays yours for one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈteɪbəl steɪz jɔrz fɔr wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 你那桌幫你多留一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour more, the board can change again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər mɔr ðə bɔrd kæn tʃeɪndʒ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 多一小時，看板也可能再變。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, so keep your eyes on row four.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru soʊ kip jɔr aɪz ɑn roʊ fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 是的，所以盯著第四列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Row four, and my bag stays by me.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ fɔr ænd maɪ bæɡ steɪz baɪ mi./
dialogue.zh: 第四列，我的袋子放在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, staff never move guest bags here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd stæf ˈnɛvər muv ɡɛst bæɡz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 很好，這裡人員不會動旅客行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never move bags, that is a comfort.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər muv bæɡz ðæt ɪz ə ˈkʌmfərt./
dialogue.zh: 不會亂動行李，這讓人安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We carry only lost things to the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈkæri ˈoʊnli lɔst θɪŋz tu ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 我們只把遺失物送到工作台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lost things at the desk, like a small office.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔst θɪŋz æt ðə dɛsk laɪk ə smɔl ˈɔfɪs./
dialogue.zh: 遺失物放在台邊，像個小招領處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, we return about ten each week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wi rɪˈtɜrn əˈbaʊt tɛn itʃ wik./
dialogue.zh: 差不多，每週約歸還十件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten a week, someone loses umbrellas here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ə wik ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈluːzɪz ʌmˈbrɛləz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 一週十件，總有人在這丟雨傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Umbrellas, chargers, and one false tooth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌmˌbrɛləz ˈtʃɑrdʒərz ænd wʌn fɔls tuθ./
dialogue.zh: 雨傘、充電線，還有一個假牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A false tooth, that is a surprise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fɔls tuθ ðæt ɪz ə sərˈpraɪz./
dialogue.zh: 假牙，那真讓人吃驚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We keep a drawer just for such things.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kip ə drɔr dʒʌst fɔr sʌtʃ θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 我們有個抽屜專放這種東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look again, row four has new letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk əˈɡɛn roʊ fɔr hæz nuː ˈlɛtərz./
dialogue.zh: 再看一次，第四列有新字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, gate B seven is now B nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡeɪt bi ˈsɛvən ɪz naʊ bi naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，B7 現在變成 B9。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: B nine, that is closer, thank goodness.
dialogue.phonetic: /bi naɪn ðæt ɪz ˈkloʊsər θæŋk ˈɡʊdnɪs./
dialogue.zh: B9 反而比較近，謝天謝地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closer, and past the quiet room door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊsər ænd pæst ðə ˈkwaɪət rum dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 比較近，在安靜室門再過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Past that door, so no long walk this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðæt dɔr soʊ noʊ lɔŋ wɔk ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 過了那門，這次不用走遠路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No long walk, and your son can rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ lɔŋ wɔk ænd jɔr sʌn kæn rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 不用走遠，你兒子也能繼續睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He sleeps deep, the blanket covers him.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi slips dip ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ˈkʌvərz hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 他睡得很沉，毛毯蓋著他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him be, we have half an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɪm bi wi hæv hæf ɑn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 別吵他，我們還有半小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half an hour, I will watch the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ɑn ˈaʊər aɪ wɪl wɑtʃ ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 半小時，我會盯著看板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch it, I will bring water and news.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ɪt aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ˈwɔtər ænd nuz./
dialogue.zh: 你盯著，我拿水和消息過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water and news, you take good care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ænd nuz ju teɪk ɡʊd kɛr./
dialogue.zh: 水和消息，你們照顧得很周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the job here, watch and tell.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə dʒɑb hɪr wɑtʃ ænd tɛl./
dialogue.zh: 工作在這裡就是看著再告訴你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will stay right here near row four.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl steɪ raɪt hɪr nɪr roʊ fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我會守在第四列這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, and I keep an eye on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ænd aɪ kip ɑn aɪ ɑn ju./
dialogue.zh: 很好，我也會留意你們這一家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our boarding time moved back one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːr ˈbɔrdɪŋ taɪm muːvd bæk wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 我們的登機時間往後延了一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I see your pass for the delay?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ ɑːi siː jʊər pæs fɔːr ðə dɪˈleɪ./
dialogue.zh: 能給我看你延誤那班的搭機證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is, delayed until ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɪr ɪt ɪz dɪˈleɪd ʌnˈtɪl tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 給您，我的班機延誤到十點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That grants you one extra lounge hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡrænts juː wʌn ˈɛkstrə laʊndʒ ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 那讓你多留貴賓室一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the extra hour free with gold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði ˈɛkstrə ˈaʊər fri wɪð ɡoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 黃金卡多留一小時免費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it costs nothing for your tier.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt kɔːsts ˈnʌθɪŋ fɔːr jʊər tɪər./
dialogue.zh: 是的，你的級別完全不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a stamp for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɑːi niːd ə stæmp fɔːr ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 那樣我需要蓋個章嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stamp needed, just scan at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stæmp ˈnidɪd dʒʌst skæn æt ðə dɔːr./
dialogue.zh: 不用蓋章，在門口再刷一次就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I wait for the new call?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ɑːi weɪt fɔːr ðə nu kɔːl./
dialogue.zh: 新的叫號我要在哪裡等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay seated here, we knock before boarding.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ˈsɪtɪd hɪr wi nɑːk bɪˈfɔːr ˈbɔːrdɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 就在原位坐著，登機前我們來敲桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son asked if we sleep here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn æskt ɪf wi slip hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子問我們會不會睡在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet zone cots open after nine thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət zoʊn kɑts ˈoʊpən ˈæftər naɪn ˈθɜːrti./
dialogue.zh: 九點半後安靜區的小床開放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he have the cot near the wall?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi hæv ðə kɑt nɪr ðə wɔːl./
dialogue.zh: 他能要牆邊那張小床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two wall cots remain, I hold one now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː wɔːl kɑts rɪˈmeɪn ɑːi hoʊld wʌn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 牆邊還剩兩張，我現在先留一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the buffet stay open that late?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə bʊˈfeɪ steɪ ˈoʊpən ðæt leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 自助餐到那麼晚還開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold trays stay, hot food ends at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld treɪz steɪ hɑt fuːd ɛndz æt naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 冷盤留著，熱食九點收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more soup sounds good right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔːr suːp saʊndz ɡʊd raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在來一碗湯聽起來真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring a bowl to your table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑːi wɪl brɪŋ ə boʊl tə jʊər ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我端一碗到你的桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee too, please, but weak tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔːfi tuː pliːz bʌt wiːk təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 也要咖啡，但今晚請泡淡一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weak cup coming, sleep comes easier then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wiːk kʌp ˈkʌmɪŋ slip kʌmz ˈiːziər ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 淡咖啡就好，那樣比較好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my bag tag get reprinted now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ bæɡ tæɡ ɡɛt ˈriprɪntɪd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 班次改了，行李吊牌現在會重印嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gate staff reprint tags, we cannot do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡeɪt stæf ˈriprɪnt tæɡz wi ˈkænɑt du ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 登機口人員才重印，我們辦不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which desk handles that, the transfer counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ dɛsk ˈhændəlz ðæt ðə ˈtrænsfɜːr ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 那個櫃台在哪裡，是轉機台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the lounge lift, left by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə laʊndʒ lɪft lɛft baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 過了貴賓室電梯，靠左窗邊就是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep my boarding pass printed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ɑːi kiːp maɪ ˈbɔːrdɪŋ pæs ˈprɪntɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我的登機證還要留紙本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, screens fail when crowds gather.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ɪt skriːnz feɪl wɛn kraʊdz ˈɡæðər./
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，人擠時螢幕常當掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our seat numbers changed too, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər siːt ˈnʌmbərz tʃeɪndʒd tuː ɑːi θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想我們的座位號也變了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row eighteen stays, only the aisle moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊ ˌeɪˈtin steɪz ˈoʊnli ði ˈaɪəl muːvd./
dialogue.zh: 十八排沒變，只有走道位調整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That aisle swap helps my wide shoulders.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈaɪəl swɑp hɛlps maɪ waɪd ˈʃoʊldərz./
dialogue.zh: 換到走道對我寬肩膀比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a pillow for the flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə ˈpɪloʊ fɔːr ðə flaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這顆枕頭給你帶上飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a pillow allowed onboard without charge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə ˈpɪloʊ əˈlaʊd ˈɑnbɔːrd wɪˈðaʊt tʃɑːrdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 枕頭可以免費帶上飛機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it fits the seat pocket easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt fɪts ðə siːt ˈpɑkɪt ˈiːzəli./
dialogue.zh: 可以，剛好塞進椅背口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do you stay staffed tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du ju steɪ stæft təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚你們櫃台開到幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We stay open until your group boards.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi steɪ ˈoʊpən ʌnˈtɪl jʊər ɡrup bɔːrdz./
dialogue.zh: 我們會開到你們那批登機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who wakes us if the gate changes again?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu weɪks ʌs ɪf ðə ɡeɪt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 登機門再改，誰來叫醒我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wake you, write your table on this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑːi weɪk ju raɪt jʊər ˈteɪbəl ɑːn ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我叫你，把桌號寫在這張單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Table nine, the round one by plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪbəl naɪn ðə raʊnd wʌn baɪ plænts./
dialogue.zh: 九號桌，植物旁邊那張圓桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine noted, I check every twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈnoʊtɪd ɑːi tʃɛk ˈɛvri ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 九號記下了，我每二十分鐘看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your staff truly work odd night hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊər stæf ˈtruːli wɜrk ɑːd naɪt ˈaʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 你們真的都上很怪的夜班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Odd hours suit airports, sleep comes in shifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑːd ˈaʊərz suːt ˈɛrpɔːrts slip kʌmz ɪn ʃɪfts./
dialogue.zh: 機場就適合怪時段，連睡覺都排班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wife should shower before the new time.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ waɪf ʃʊd ˈʃaʊər bɪˈfɔːr ðə nu taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我妻子得在那個新時間前洗澡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room two is free, towel and robe ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruːm tu ɪz fri ˈtaʊəl ænd roʊb ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 二號空著，毛巾和袍子都備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Robes there are clean, I hope?
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊbz ðɛr ɑːr klin ɑːi hoʊp./
dialogue.zh: 那裡的袍子是乾淨的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh laundered batch arrives every morning here.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ˈlɔːndərd bætʃ əˈraɪvz ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 每早都有一批洗好送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That answers my worry about shared robes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈænsərz maɪ ˈwɜːri əˈbaʊt ʃɛrd roʊbz./
dialogue.zh: 這打消了我對共用袍子的擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spare robes live in that closed cabinet.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɛr roʊbz lɪv ɪn ðæt kloʊzd ˈkæbɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 備用袍子放在那個有門的櫃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does our delay voucher cover a hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ˈaʊər dɪˈleɪ ˈvaʊtʃər ˈkʌvər ə hoʊˈtɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我們的延誤折價券能抵旅館嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only overnight cancellations qualify, tonight no.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈoʊvərˌnaɪt ˈkænsəˌleɪʃənz ˈkwɑːləˌfaɪ təˈnaɪt noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 只給過夜取消的，今晚用不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we sleep here until you call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi slip hɪr ʌnˈtɪl ju kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就在這裡睡到你們叫號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cot, blanket, and quiet lamp are yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑt ˈblæŋkɪt ænd ˈkwaɪət læmp ɑːrz jɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 小床、毛毯和安靜台燈都給你們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the blanket drawer, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈblæŋkɪt drɔr pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 請問毛毯抽屜在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second drawer, folded, beside the reading light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd drɔr ˈfoʊldɪd bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈriːdɪŋ laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 第二格抽屜，摺好的，在閱讀燈旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One blanket each, so three total then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈblæŋkɪt itʃ soʊ θri ˈtoʊtəl ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 一人一條，三個人共三條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three folded plus one spare, four in all.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈfoʊldɪd plʌs wʌn spɛr fɔːr ɪn ɔːl./
dialogue.zh: 三條加備用一條，總共四條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your memory for numbers really amazes me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊər ˈmɛməri fɔːr ˈnʌmbərz ˈrɪli əˈmeɪz mi./
dialogue.zh: 你對數字的記憶真讓我驚訝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nights are dull, counting keeps us awake.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪts ɑːr dʌl ˈkaʊntɪŋ kiːps ʌs əˈweɪk./
dialogue.zh: 夜裡無聊，數東西讓人保持清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is low, need an outlet.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz loʊ nid ən ˈaʊtˌlɛt./
dialogue.zh: 我手機電量低，需要插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under your table, plus a charging strip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər jʊər ˈteɪbəl plʌs ə ˈtʃɑːrdʒɪŋ strɪp./
dialogue.zh: 在你桌子下面，還有充電條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A strip with four ports suits our three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə strɪp wɪð fɔːr pɔːrts suːts ˈaʊər θri./
dialogue.zh: 四孔的充電條剛好夠我們三個用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unplug before boarding, cords get collected then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈplʌɡ bɪˈfɔːr ˈbɔːrdɪŋ kɔːrdz ɡɛt kəˈlɛktɪd ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 登機前要拔插頭，線會收走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who collects cords, the cleaner or you?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu kəˈlɛkts kɔːrdz ðə ˈklinər ɔːr ju./
dialogue.zh: 充電線是誰收，清潔人員還是你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cleaners take them, note your charger color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinərz teɪk ðɛm noʊt jʊər ˈtʃɑːrdʒər ˈkʌlər./
dialogue.zh: 清潔人員收，記好你充電器的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine is blue with a torn sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz blu wɪð ə tɔːrn sliːv./
dialogue.zh: 我的是藍色，外皮破了一角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue with a tear, I will watch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu wɪð ə tɪr ɑːi wɪl wɑːtʃ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 藍色破皮的，我會幫你留意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That kindness matters after a long day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkaɪndnəs ˈmætərz ˈæftər ə lɔŋ deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這種體貼在累了一整天後特別珍貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Airports are hard, small help goes far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛrˌpɔːrts ɑːr hɑːrd smɔːl hɛlp ɡoʊz fɑːr./
dialogue.zh: 機場日子辛苦，小忙幫很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we recheck the gate once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˌriːˈtʃɛk ðə ɡeɪt wʌns mɔːr./
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要再確認一次登機門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the board at nine forty, no earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə bɔːrd æt naɪn ˈfɔːrti noʊ ˈɜːrliər./
dialogue.zh: 九點四十再看看板，別太早去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine forty leaves time for teeth washing.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈfɔːrti liːvz taɪm fɔːr tiːθ ˈwɑːʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 九點四十還夠我去刷牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Basins sit left of the shower corridor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪsənz sɪt lɛft ʌv ðə ˈʃaʊər ˈkɔːrəˌdɔːr./
dialogue.zh: 洗手盆在淋浴走廊左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toothbrushes are sold, or does the lounge give?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuːθˌbrʌʃəz ɑːr soʊld ɔːr dʌz ðə laʊndʒ ɡɪv./
dialogue.zh: 牙刷是賣的，還是貴賓室提供？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free kits live in that third small drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri kɪts lɪv ɪn ðæt θɜːrd smɔːl drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 免費牙刷包在第三個小抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third drawer noted, you answer many times.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜːrd drɔr ˈnoʊtɪd ju ˈænsər ˈmɛni taɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 第三格記下了，同一題你回答好多次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same eight questions nightly, I know them well.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm eɪt ˈkwɛstʃənz ˈnaɪtli ɑːi noʊ ðɛm wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 每晚就是那八個問題，我熟得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which question comes first after a delay notice?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈkwɛstʃən kʌmz fɜːrst ˈæftər ə dɪˈleɪ ˈnoʊtɪs./
dialogue.zh: 延誤通知後第一個問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is always about the seat number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɔlweɪz əˈbaʊt ðə siːt ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 一定都是問座位號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine stayed, which calms the whole family.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn steɪd wɪtʃ kɑːmz ðə hoʊl ˈfæməli./
dialogue.zh: 我的座位沒變，全家就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm families nap best in the quiet zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑːm ˈfæməliz næp bɛst ɪn ðə ˈkwaɪət zoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 情緒穩的全家在安靜區睡得最熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our boy already snores on that new cot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər bɔɪ ɔːlˈrɛdi snɔːrz ɑːn ðæt nu kɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我兒子在那張新小床已經打呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Children sleep through anything, enviable, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪldrən slip θru ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɪnˈvaɪəbəl ˈɑːnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 小孩什麼都睡得著，真令人羨慕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We adults would sleep on the floor now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi əˈdʌlts wʊd slip ɑːn ðə flɔːr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們大人現在躺地板也願意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not, the carpet gets inspected.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du nɑːt ðə ˈkɑːrpɪt ɡɛts ɪnˈspɛktɪd./
dialogue.zh: 請別這樣，地毯每天都要檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inspected for crumbs, I guess, after tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈspɛktɪd fɔːr krʌmz ɑːi ɡɛs ˈæftər təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我猜今晚過後要查麵包屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crumbs bring ants, we clean twice nightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /krʌmz brɪŋ ænts wi klin twaɪs ˈnaɪtli./
dialogue.zh: 屑會引螞蟻，我們每晚清兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ants here would end my soup habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænts hɪr wʊd ɛnd maɪ suːp ˈhæbɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這裡若有螞蟻，我喝湯的習慣就完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No ants tonight, the kitchen sprays each Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ænts təˈnaɪt ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn spreɪz itʃ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚沒有，廚房每週五都噴藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday or not, I still take soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪˌdeɪ ɔːr nɑːt ɑːi stɪl teɪk suːp./
dialogue.zh: 不管週五與否，我還是喝湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two bowls, tonight the house is paying.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu boʊlz təˈnaɪt ðə haʊs ɪz ˈpeɪɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 喝兩碗吧，今晚由貴賓室買單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your kindness beats the hotel I booked once.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊər ˈkaɪndnəs bits ðə hoʊˈtɛl ɑːi bʊkt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 你這份好意贏過我住過的一家旅館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hotels sleep strangers, here we watch names.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊˈtɛlz slip ˈstreɪndʒərz hɪr wi wɑːtʃ neɪmz./
dialogue.zh: 旅館睡的是陌生人，這裡認名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Names matter when the gate calls at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪmz ˈmætər wɛn ðə ɡeɪt kɔːlz æt tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 十點叫號時，名字就很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I call your row first, then the cots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑːi kɔːl jʊər roʊ fɜːrst ðɛn ðə kɑts./
dialogue.zh: 我先叫你那一排，再叫小床區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First call sounds good, we will be ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜːrst kɔːl saʊndz ɡʊd wi wɪl bi ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 第一輪叫最好，我們會備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready means pass, mask, and one small bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi minz pæs mæsk ænd wʌn smɔːl bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 備好就是登機證、口罩和一個小袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bag only, and I wear the slippers.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bæɡ ˈoʊnli ænd aɪ wɛr ðə ˈslɪpərz./
dialogue.zh: 只帶一袋，拖鞋我就穿在腳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wear them, the basket holds spare pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɛr ðɛm ðə ˈbæskɪt hoʊldz spɛr pɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 對，就穿著吧，籃子裡還有備用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes before, wake us both, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔːr weɪk ʌs boʊθ pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 請在十分鐘前叫醒我們兩人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both woken, both boarded, that is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈwoʊkən boʊθ ˈbɔːrdɪd ðæt ɪz maɪ dʒɑːb./
dialogue.zh: 叫你們兩個、送上兩個，就是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I sleep now, truly grateful to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɑːi slip naʊ ˈtruːli ˈɡreɪtfəl tə ju./
dialogue.zh: 那我現在就睡了，真的很感謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep deep, the delay has not moved again.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip dip ðə dɪˈleɪ hæz nɑt muvd əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 安心睡吧，延誤的時間沒有再變。
